Name: LG Electronics
Description:
Step into the world of LG Electronics, a global innovator in technology and consumer electronics focused on creating solutions for a better life. Guided by our brand promise, Life’s Good, we aim to make everyday life better, smarter and more meaningful for people around the world.

With a history spanning more than six decades, a network of more than 100 subsidiaries, and an international workforce of over 75,000, LG Electronics operates on a truly global scale. Since our founding in 1958, we have remained focused on delivering innovative products and technologies that improve lives around the world.

Through our four business divisions — Home Appliance Solution, Media Entertainment Solution, Vehicle Solution, and Eco Solution Companies — we provide innovative products and services that enhance everyday life across residential, entertainment, mobility, and HVAC sectors.

At the same time, we continue to expand into new growth areas including AI Home, smart factories, robotics and platform-based services such as webOS, building on our strengths in both consumer technology and B2B solutions.

Our management philosophy, Jeong-do Management, reflects our commitment to integrity, transparency and doing business the right way. Built on the principles of customer value creation and people-oriented management, our culture encourages collaboration, creativity and growth.

Join us as we continue to shape what comes next, because at LG, Life’s Good.

Das ROWA 4 you Filtersystem arbeitet nach dem Prinzip der Umkehrosmose und wurde ursprünglich von der NASA entwickelt, um Astronauten im Weltall mit gereinigtem Wasser zu versorgen. Wir setzen die weltweit hochwertigsten Filtermembranen ein, die bis zu 99% aller im Wasser befindlichen Belastungen beseitigt. Für reinstes Wasser im täglichen Gebrauch.
 
Seit 2015 bietet ROWA 4 you innovative und effiziente Filtersysteme zur Reinigung von Trinkwasser für die Bereiche Office, Gastronomie und Travel an.

In our latest customer projects, we have been focusing on the possibilities within Big-Data and Internet of Things (IoT). IoT describes the communication between electronic devices with the purpose of creating more available data, which creates new possibilities for improvements within the field of service solutions.


You are more than welcome to contact us if you need a competent partner to help you with surveillance, control or inspection of your hydraulic or electric operated machines.

Mit einem weltweiten Produktvertrieb in über 50 Länder gehört das Unternehmen zu den Marktführern. Mit der Gründung des neuen Produktbereichs BURDA Heatpanels (Flächenheizelemente) im Jahr 2014 stellt Burda WTG seine Innovationskraft erneut unter Beweis und stellt die Weichen für einen neuen Geschäftsbereich mit starkem Umsatzpotenzial.

Name: Spohr-Messtechnik
Description:
Die Firma Spohr wurde 1884 von Christian Spohr gegründet. Die Firma beschäftigte sich von Beginn an mit der Herstellung von elektrischen Wasserstandsanzeigern. Daneben wurden auch Telefon- und Telegrafenanlagen, sowie Uhrenanlagen (Turmuhren) hergestellt. Bis 1905 war Christian Spohr Stadtuhrmacher der Stadt Frankfurt.
1901 hatte ein Mitarbeiter der Firma die Idee zu einem "Rillen-Brunnenmesser mit akustischem Signal". Diese "Ur-Brunnenpfeife" wurde 1902 als Gebrauchsmuster eingetragen.

Carl Spohr (1877 – 1957) leitete die Firma ab 1908. Hauptsächlich mit der Herstellung und Montage komplexer elektrischer Uhrenanlagen und mit Reparaturen von Schaltanlagen beschäftigt, wurde auch weiterhin die Entwicklung der Wasserstandsmesstechnik vorangebracht.

Heinz Spohr (1912 – 2002) trat 1931 in die Firma ein und wurde 1939 Teilhaber. Er konzentrierte sich besonders auf die Wasserstandsmesstechnik und erfand schon 1933 das "Lichtlot" (DRGM1279419 "Tauchsenkel mit Lichtsignal") , welches in den 50er Jahren zum "Kabellichtlot" weiterentwickelt wurde . Lichtlot und Brunnepfeife sind im Deutschen Museum in München ausgestellt. Außerdem wurden verschiedene Modelle von Schwimmer Schreibpegeln für unterschiedliche Einsatzzwecke entwickelt.

1979 wurde der Geschäftsbetrieb auf die neu gegründete SPOHR-Messtechnik GmbH übertragen, deren Geschäftsführung Peter Spohr (geb. 1949) übernahm. 

Seit Jahrzehnten ist die Produktion in der Firma Spohr handwerklich organisiert. Eine hohe Qualifikation sowie Selbstständigkeit und Eigenverantwortung bei der Arbeit sind bei allen Mitarbeitern selbstverständlich. Hierdurch werden eine gleichbleibend hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit der Geräte und ein flexibler, langjähriger Service sichergestellt Eine rationelle innerbetriebliche Abwicklung und ein minimaler Verwaltungsaufwand sorgen für ein besonders günstiges Preis-/Qualitätsverhältnis bei allen Geräten, Ersatzteilen und Dienstleistungen.

The era of globalization has fostered the migration of viruses to new continents, leading to a constant battle against the spread of disease. These infections lead to significant morbidity and mortality.

Our support to the medical and commercial sectors by spreading the concept of microbiological safety aims to solve these problems through prevention, detection, surveillance and infection control.

OCTA-UV Multisystem - is a special system for chemical-free UV-C light disinfection, which provides fast and effective disinfection or sterilization . It consists three Emitters, which automatically calculate the effective dose of UV-C radiation and are driven by dedicated software.

Our tool is the technological answer to the needs of healthcare facilities for disinfecting and sterilizing rooms.

Zahlreiche weitere Anwendungen für die Technologie finden sich bspw. im alpinen Sommersport, im Outdoor–und Funsport sowie im Katastrophenschutz.

Ein weiteres Geschäftsfeld ist der Sondermaschinenbau mit Robotik, Kamera- und Automatisierungstechnik. FROLYT plant und realisiert kundenspezifische Montage- und Prüfanlagen, integriert Robotersysteme und industrielle Kameratechnik und bindet neue Lösungen in bestehende Produktionsprozesse ein – von Konstruktion und Fertigung bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

Im Bereich Stromversorgungsanlagen plant und realisiert FROLYT individuelle DC-Versorgungssysteme, USV- und Redundanzlösungen sowie Schaltschrank- und Leitungsinstallationen. Montage, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme beim Kunden gehören ebenfalls zum Leistungsumfang.

Vier Geschäftsfelder, ein gemeinsamer Anspruch: technische Lösungen für Anwendungen, bei denen Standard nicht ausreicht. Seit 1947 entwickelt und gefertigt am Standort Freiberg in Sachsen.

Do you need to provide proof of machine capability for an audit?

Ob du feine Flocken, aromatisches Mehl oder hausgemachtes Brot liebst – wir haben das passende Equipment und die besten Zutaten für dich.

Was bieten wir dir?
Mit unseren Getreidemühlen mahlst du dein Mehl frisch und entdeckst den unvergleichlichen Geschmack und die Nährstoffe, die nur selbstgemachtes Mehl bieten kann. Unsere Flocker machen aus einfachem Getreide im Handumdrehen frische Flocken für dein Frühstück oder deine Lieblingsrezepte. Einfach flocken, anrühren, genießen – so easy und so lecker! 

Was treibt uns an?
Wir bei Grainlovers haben nicht nur Geschmack im Kopf, sondern auch die Umwelt im Blick. Deshalb setzen wir auf nachhaltige Materialien und recycelbare Verpackungen. Uns ist wichtig, dass du nicht nur gut isst, sondern dabei auch ein gutes Gefühl hast. Wir glauben daran, dass gesunde Ernährung und Umweltschutz Hand in Hand gehen können – und genau das wollen wir dir ermöglichen. 

Warum Grainlovers?

Name: SZM
Description:
More than 300 upgrade solutions for medium-voltage switchgear devices have been successfully installed in various industries all over the world, making SZM the world’s #1 most trusted supplier of Retrofit solutions. 

Retrofit by SZM, is a programme in which the old switchgear is replaced by a modern one, help customers to save time and money, conserve resources, and increase the reliability, safety and service life of the equipment.

Our Retrofit solutions are therefore a popular alternative to purchasing a new equipment, because in a Retrofit we "only" modernise the core component of a switchgear - its "heart", so to speak. The system structure itself remains untouched. However, by using the latest technology in switchgear we bring the old equipment up-to-date and give it a significantly longer service life. In addition, a retrofit saves the time-consuming planning and alterations. The upgraded switchgear is installed directly in the old system by plug-and-play.

A Retrofit is the better choice from an economical point of view, because the investment costs are much lower and thanks to the state-of-the-art switchgear, the system subsequently operates more efficiently and of course, requires less maintenance. 

Such solutions are possible as a result of an in-house department that is dedicated to research and development and has the expertise to implement its own projects as well as for the engineering/consulting of individual customer solutions in the field of energy technology. For this purpose, we offer prototype and sample construction as well as standing AC voltage tests up to 100,000 V in our own modern electrical test field for switchgear.

In addition to Retrofit solutions, we also manufacture switchgear and other electrical components such as vacuum circuit-breakers, switch-disconnectors and drives for them, load break switches and earthing switches and offer spare parts and service for old SCI switches as well as products from different manufacturers.

Name: Parsum GmbH
Description:
Measuring particle size in running processes - Parsum stands for this since over 20 years with its own complete solutions.

Founded in 1997 by former employees of Chemnitz University of Technology, Parsum has now become a recognized international supplier of PAT solutions for the chemical and pharmaceutical industries. At the beginning was a patented measuring principle and the conviction that there is a great need in industry and R&D to measure particle sizes directly in the process to monitor, control and optimize these processes.
From the beginning, Parsum used the in-line measurement, where particles do not have to leave the process space and the measurement results are available immediately and continuously. Several patents were granted for this procedure in Germany, Europe and the USA.
The Parsum Probe design without mechanically adjustable parts has become an important success factor and has been maintained up to today's probe types. As a result, installation in existing systems is easily possible.
In addition to the fine chemicals, food and basic industries, with the IPP 70- probe type Parsum offers a GMP-compliant solution for the pharmaceutical industry. Above all, the consistent development of accessories for particle dispersion and process adjustment, the so-called "Process Interface", led to Parsum becoming a market leader in the field of particle measurement in fluidized bed processes. The unique Inline dispersing technology in particular contributed to the fact that the measuring probes can also determine the particle size distribution in very dense, moist and dusty processes.
Parsum is thus in a very good position for future business. In addition to the general trend towards "Industry 4.0" this is promoted in the pharmaceutical industry mainly by the increasing direct integration of PAT into new production facilities and a growing trend towards continuous production processes.

The partnership enhances manufacturing flexibility across the United States and Mexico, supporting customer requirements related to US domestic production, Buy America / Build America (BABA), USMCA compliance, and evolving tariff environments.

At GPV, partnership is proven through action. Every day, we work to deliver timely, faultless, and high-quality solutions, while remaining a reliable and proactive partner in an increasingly complex global environment.

GPV has been part of the Danish industrial conglomerate Schouw & Co. since 2016 and is jointly owned by Schouw & Co. (80%) and Ahlström Capital (20%).

Name: Innovative Technology Ltd
Description:
For more than thirty years we have been at the forefront of innovation in transaction automation.

We have two main divisions: cash handling equipment and AI-powered biometric solutions.

Established as a leading provider of cash handling equipment we enable customers to automate cash payments throughout the world; manufacturing multi-coin hoppers, banknote validators and recyclers that handle millions of transactions every day for some of the world’s leading companies.

This desire to continually innovate has led to the development of our AI powered biometric solutions division. Using facial analysis to intelligently identify people more efficiently and securely, our solutions allow customers to easily add age estimation and access control functionality to their existing equipment or premises.

As an innovation-led global technology company, we research and develop a broad range of products that reduce operational costs and maximise efficiency for the gaming, retail, kiosk, amusement and vending markets.  We have a reputation for excellence in developing products that improve the customer experience and that are affordable, reliable and responsive to both business and customer needs in a rapidly changing world.

We have a growing international presence with commercial operations across the globe, two manufacturing sites, a rapidly expanding R&D centre and a network of over 20 trading partners.

Name: TA Instruments
Description:
Waters Materials Sciences (Formerly TA Instruments) provides innovative material characterization instruments that are widely used for research, analysis, and quality control in the evaluation of physical properties. We are the world’s leading supplier of thermal analysis, rheology, and microcalorimetry instruments, and our product areas have expanded to include thermal conductivity & diffusivity, dilatometry, rubber testing, and dynamic mechanical characterization.  

Waters Materials Sciences (Formerly TA Instruments’) reputation for high technology products, quality manufacturing and unbeatable after sales support is why more customers recommend TA products to their colleagues around the world. Headquartered in New Castle, Delaware, TA Instruments prides itself on the technical competence and professionalism that our sales force offers, as well as the largest worldwide service and support team in the industry. We are the only thermal analysis, rheology, and microcalorimetry supplier recognized worldwide for our prompt, courteous and knowledgeable service staff, the hallmark of our company. With direct operations in 24 countries, we are uniquely positioned to support all of our customers with an extensive local support network. We are committed to providing high reliability and high-performance products to meet the needs of our customers.

Name: BARTEC
Description:
BARTEC is a leading global provider of hazardous area safety and security solutions, products, and services. With its advanced technologies and performance-oriented teams of experts, BARTEC helps renowned customers from a wide range of industries and regions to secure working environments, meet legal requirements, and improve productivity. Founded in 1975 in Bad Mergentheim/Germany, the company with its approximately 1,000 employees is a specialist in explosion protection and safety technology that sets global standards - always committed to the BARTEC mission statement: Protecting what is most important. More at bartec.com.

Legal Information and Data Protection can be found under:
https://bartec.com/imprint
https://bartec.com/privacy-policy

Name: Spectris
Description:
Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. We provide critical insights to our customers through premium precision measurement solutions combined with technical expertise and deep domain knowledge. 

Precision is at the heart of what we do - our leading, high-tech instruments and software equip our customers to solve some of their greatest  challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive. 

We are focused on two key divisions – Spectris Scientific and Spectris Dynamics, which are placed in technology-driven end  markets, with strong fundamentals and attractive growth trajectories. 

We have leading market positions in premium segments and employ 7,000 people located in 35 countries, all united behind our purpose to deliver value beyond measure for all our stakeholders.  We are headquartered in London, United Kingdom. 

Visit the Spectris website for more information: www.spectris.com

Learn more about our operating companies by visiting the websites below: 
Malvern Panalytical (www.malvernpanalytical.com) 
HBK (www.hbkworld.com)
Particle Measuring Systems (www.pmeasuring.com)
Servomex (www.servomex.com)

Name: BEGA
Description:
BEGA. Das gute Licht.

For more than eighty years now, BEGA has been developing and producing high-quality luminaires for almost all areas of architecture. These years have given rise to products whose ideas and trademarks have become generic terms for countless luminaires in the entire industry.

Our daily work is determined by our high standards in lighting technology, workmanship and usability as well as the aesthetic quality of our luminaires. Our common goal is to create durable assets which will remain timeless in terms of design, even after decades.

Our luminaires are intended to fit in harmoniously as good construction details and as part of the architecture, and perform their task for many years. Their light should underline the architecture, set the scene atmospherically or dramatically, or simply maintain its plastic appearance at night.

Our luminaires are lighting tools for the many different design ideas of all those who plan and design with light.

The objective of our work is to maintain the plastic effect as well as the three-dimensional experience of the outside world for mankind, at night as well.

Imprint: https://www.bega.com/en/legal/imprint
Location: Limburg an der Lahn, Hesse, Germany

Name: Seyond
Description:
SeyondTM is the industry leader in directional LiDAR, powering the future of mobility, intelligent infrastructure, and automation. With four LiDAR manufacturing facilities and proven mass-production capabilities, Seyond delivers image-grade LiDAR solutions for ADAS, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), robotics, stationary sensing, and off-road applications.

Founded in Silicon Valley and supported by global research, engineering, and manufacturing operations, Seyond offers one of the industry's most complete LiDAR portfolios, spanning short-range, mid-range, long-range, and ultra-long-range sensing solutions. Combined with advanced perception software, Seyond's technologies enable safer, smarter, and more autonomous systems across a wide range of real-world environments.

To date, Seyond has delivered more than 1 million LiDAR sensors worldwide, helping leading customers accelerate the deployment of autonomous driving, smart infrastructure, and next-generation automation.

See SmarterTM.

Name: Panasonic Connect Europe
Description:
With the Panasonic Group’s transition to a holding company system, Panasonic Connect Europe GmbH, which leads the B2B solutions business, is newly established.

In order to respond to the ever-changing market environment, we are transforming our organisation to enable rapid decision-making and further enhance our competitiveness, to better help innovate processes in our customers' operating sites.

The company name change reflects the goal to "connect" our customers’ operations to a better future.

By connecting our specialised hardware with the latest technologies such as process management software, IoT, and AI, and using the knowledge and expertise cultivated in our long history of manufacturing to provide advanced services, we will create value for our customers and provide solutions to their challenges.

Panasonic Connect Europe consist of the following business units: 
 
•	The Mobile Solutions Business Division helping mobile workers improve productivity with its range of Toughbook rugged notebooks, business tablets and handhelds

•	The Media Entertainment Business Division incorporating Visual System Solutions offering a range of high brightness and reliable projectors as well as high quality displays; and Broadcast & ProAV offering Smart Live Production solutions from an end-to-end portfolio consisting of PTZ and system cameras, camcorders, the Kairos IT/IP platform, switchers and robotic solutions that are widely used for live event capture, sports production, television, and xR studios

•	Business and Industry Solutions delivering tailored technology solutions focused on Retail, Logistics and Manufacturing. Designed to increase operational efficiency and enhance customer experience, helping businesses to perform at their best, every day

•	Panasonic Factory Solutions Europe selling a wide range of smart factory solutions including electronics manufacturing solutions, robot and welding systems and software solutions engineering.

Name: Basler AG
Description:
Basler is a leading international manufacturer of imaging components for computer vision applications such as cameras, lenses, frame grabbers, software as well as embedded vision solutions, customized products and consulting services. 
The products are used in a variety of computer vision markets, including factory automation, medical, traffic, logistics, retail, and robotics. Founded in 1988, the Basler Group employs approximately 1000 people at its headquarters in Ahrensburg and other locations in Europe, Asia and North America.

Name: RZB Lighting
Description:
As a lighting and luminaire multi-specialist, RZB Rudolf Zimmermann, Bamberg GmbH - RZB for short - has stood for over 85 years of intelligent lighting solutions "Made in Germany". As a diversified group of companies, we have a considerable vertical range of manufacture in Bamberg. The focus of our internationally operating family business is on the development and production of indoor and outdoor luminaires, emergency luminaires and efficient lighting management systems. A new addition to the portfolio is the RZB Energy brand with a new, fully modular concept of luminaires with integrated charging functions.

News: https://www.rzb.de/en/company/news/

Name: Cicor Group
Description: Cicor is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced electronic solutions. Serving the healthcare technology, industrial electronics and aerospace & defence sectors, our full-cycle approach combines engineering excellence with high-precision production to bring ideas to life. Together with our customers, we create electronics that make the world a healthier, more connected and safer place.

Name: Luceco Group
Description:
Luceco Group is a global business that manufactures and distributes high-quality and innovative LED lighting products, EV Chargers, Electrical Wiring Devices and Accessories, Circuit Protection, Portable Power solutions, and Audio-Visual / Home Entertainment products worldwide. Offering our customers ‘Everything under one roof’ for any sector including trade, retail, independent, online and many more.

Our reputation is based on the reliability, sustainability, innovation and functionality of our products. By offering market-leading guarantees and warranties, technical support, dedicated customer service and marketing backup, we aim to make it easy for customers to specify and install sustainable lighting.

We are fully committed to improving environmental performance across all of our manufacturing and other business activities, continually looking for new methods and materials to provide environmentally friendly solutions. 

The teams behind Luceco Group group have over 100 years of combined lighting and electrical industry experience.

The Luceco Group brands include Luceco Lighting (LED Lighting), BG Electrical (Wiring Accessories), BG SyncEV (EV Chargers), Masterplug (Portable Power), Ross (AV Accessories) DW Windsor and Kingfisher (Exterior Lighting & Accessories).

Name: Raymarine
Description:
Teledyne Raymarine, a world leader in marine electronics, develops and manufactures the most comprehensive range of electronic equipment for the recreational boating and light commercial marine markets. Designed for high performance and ease of use, the award-winning products are available through a global network of dealers and distributors. 

The Raymarine product lines include radar, autopilots, GPS, instruments, fishfinders, communications, and integrated systems. Headquartered in Portsmouth UK, Raymarine is a division of Teledyne FLIR. For more information about Raymarine please go to  www.raymarine.com

About Teledyne FLIR 
Teledyne FLIR, a Teledyne Technologies company, is a world leader in intelligent sensing solutions for defense and industrial applications with approximately 4,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 1978, the company creates advanced technologies to help professionals make better, faster decisions that save lives and livelihoods. For more information, please visit www.teledyneflir.com

Name: Carlo Gavazzi Automation
Description:
Carlo Gavazzi is an international group engaged in the design, manufacturing, and marketing of electronic control components for the global building and industrial automation markets.

Its factories in Italy, Mexico, Lithuania, Malta, and China are certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 standards. 

The company’s product portfolio—including sensors, solid-state relays, energy meters and analyzers, IoT energy management systems, monitoring relays, soft starters, timers, power supplies, and safety devices—delivers comprehensive automation solutions for both industrial and building applications. 

Typical customers include original equipment manufacturers in sectors such as access control, agriculture, conveyors, distributed energy resources, energy efficiency, energy storage, EV charging infrastructure, food & beverage, HVAC, mobile equipment, plastics & rubber, and semiconductors. In addition, system integrators and distributors play a key role as effective market channels. 

Carlo Gavazzi markets its products worldwide through 23 wholly owned sales companies and approximately 60 independent national distributors, covering Europe, the Americas, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Name: Marelli Motori
Description:
Marelli Motori is a leading manufacturer of electric motors and generators. 

Founded in northern Italy in 1891, the company enjoys worldwide brand recognition in the marine, oil & gas, power generation, co-generation, hydro, and other industrial sectors. 
Marelli Motori is a leading manufacturer of electric motors and generators. 

Founded in northern Italy in 1891, the company enjoys worldwide brand recognition in the marine, oil & gas, power generation, co-generation, hydro, and other industrial sectors. 

Marelli Motori employs around 550 people and operates an extensive manufacturing facility in Italy with own subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, South Africa and Malaysia and has an extended sales, distribution, and service network across four continents, supplying its technologically advanced products in more than 120 countries.

In 2019, Marelli Motori was acquired by Langley Holdings plc, the British engineering and industrial group.

Name: Riello UPS
Description:
RIELLO UPS is one of the leading European company for single and three phases UPS on the range from 400 VA to 6400 kVA.

Riello UPS part of  the Riello Elettronica Group
Backed by 20 year’s experience, Riello Elettronica is the parent of a group of companies which operate in a number of sectors, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Automation, Sensors, Domotics.
Its business is focussed on the conversion of energy for industrial and civil applications. It is the European leader in the production of UPS systems (Uninterruptible Power Supply) under the brand name of Riello UPS. These systems guarantee the continuous supply of power to computers, electromedical and industrial equipment and radar and telecommunication systems. Riello Elettronica also operates in the automation and industrial and home security sector alongside international partners such as AVS Electronics, Telcoma Automation, Innovatech Sweethome and Ceimu.

The objective of RIELLO UPS is to supply global solutions that guarantee power quality; through R&D investments and the manufacture of resilient and efficient products.
Power Quality can be defined using two parameters:
• Continuity - guaranteeing a stable and secure electrical supply
• Quality - in terms of frequency, voltage, waveform and energy efficiency
Riello UPS provides value added in the form of Power Quality – its extensive product range guarantees that the company has an energy solution for any critical application.

Name: Speedgoat
Description:
Driven to support acceleration of technological and scientific breakthroughs for the benefit of future generations.
 
Speedgoat is connecting Simulink control designs and plant simulations with the physical world, enabling rapid innovation and automated testing of complex real-time control systems in a more electrified and AI enabled autonomous world.
 
Core real-time simulation and testing workflows supported include Rapid Control Prototyping, Bypassing, XCP Monitoring and Calibration, Restbus Simulation, Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation, Hybrid Physical/Digital and Digital Twins, Virtual Commissioning, Predictive Maintenance, and related Test Automation.

Name: TD Power Systems
Description:
TD Power Systems is an ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 certified global technological leader in AC Generator and Motor Manufacturing, catering to industry verticals like renewables, co-generation, hydroelectric, oil & gas, electrical traction, marine and wind power. TDPS has more than two decades of experience in manufacturing custom electrical generators with a global footprint in nearly 111 Countries and 7200+ installations, making it a pioneer in the market.
The company offers end-to-end, flexible solutions with state-of-the-art manufacturing systems, custom-built for the diverse needs of clients from across the globe. Headquartered in India and with sales offices in Japan, USA & Germany, TDPS also has a vast network of 60 service providers in 6 continents; helping it address customer needs with an exceedingly high level of precision and agility.

Name: CustomCells
Description:
CustomCells is a German developer and manufacturer of high-performance lithium-ion battery cells, founded in 2012.
Headquartered in Itzehoe, Germany, CustomCells combines advanced battery cell development with flexible manufacturing capabilities, operating R&D facilities and scalable production lines from laboratory and prototype builds through to series-ready cell production.

Following the addition of a new ownership group in July 2025, CustomCells and its team of around 100 employees continue to focus on customized battery cell solutions for the most demanding applications in defense, aerospace, motorsport and other high-tech industries.

The company’s portfolio spans material evaluation, cell and process development, prototyping, industrialization support, built-to-print manufacturing and custom high-performance battery cells. With more than 13 years of experience, over 3,500 completed projects and more than 500 customers served, including leading technology and automotive companies, 

CustomCells has established itself as one of Europe’s leading independent battery cell specialists, delivering tailored solutions for applications where performance, reliability and technological excellence are critical.

Name: XCHARGE Europe
Description: XCharge is a global supplier of high-performance electric vehicle charging solutions and energy storage solutions. The company has headquarters in Hamburg and Austin, working with a globally networked team to drive innovation in the field of energy and help its customers achieve long-term success.

Name: Dynaudio
Description: For 45 years, we have been combining high fidelity audio, enhanced performance, detailed imaging and powerful dynamics with exquisite design.

Name: Allied Vision
Description:
About Allied Vision
Allied Vision stands for customer-centric 2D Machine Vision solutions, from individual components to fully integrated complete solutions. With deep application knowledge from various technology areas and industries, Allied Vision develops tailored vision solutions that enable customers to make informed decisions based on precise information. The product portfolio ranges from line scan and area scan cameras to lenses and frame grabbers, and from image processing libraries to IP cores – all from a single source. As a trusted partner with a global network of experts and local support, Allied Vision stands by its customers and partners, making collaboration as easy and reliable as possible.
Allied Vision is part of the Machine Vision division of the TKH Group.

Name: HIGHVOLT Prüftechnik Dresden GmbH
Description: HIGHVOLT Prüftechnik Dresden GmbH is a global leader in high voltage and high current test systems and measurement equipment with experience of 120 years. At the factory in Dresden, Germany, HIGHVOLT develops and manufactures systems for testing electric power equipment used to transfer electrical energy, such as transformers, cables, and switchgears. The long standing company provides complete solutions with all consulting and maintenance services from entire test bays right down to individual components.

Name: LG Business Europe
Description:
LG Electronics offers a comprehensive portfolio of Information Display and IT Business solutions designed to support professionals and organizations across industries.
From OLED and LED signage, digital displays, and commercial TVs to IT products such as monitors, laptops, projectors, cloud devices and medical displays, we deliver purpose-driven solutions tailored to the needs of professionals in Retail, Hospitality, Corporate, Education, Transport, and Healthcare sectors.
As a Total Business Solutions Provider, LG combines cutting-edge product innovation with deep industry know-how to help our clients boost productivity, enhance communication, and accelerate digital transformation.
Whether you're looking to engage audiences, enable hybrid work, or build future-ready infrastructure, LG is your partner in progress.
 
 For inquiries, contact us at: msb2beurope@lge.com

Name: Kanthal
Description:
Electrification of heating processes is a key enabler for a fossil-free industry. As a world leader in sustainable heating technology, Kanthal collaborates with energy-intensive industries such as steel, cement, petrochemical and battery to develop electric heating solutions that help minimizing their carbon footprint.

Kanthal has provided industry-leading electric heating technology to the world since 1931, when metallurgist Hans von Kantzow founded the company in Hallstahammar, Sweden, based on his discovery of the FeCrAl (iron-chrome-aluminum) alloy.

Over the years we’ve built the largest product range of resistance heating solutions for industrial applications on the market. Our ability to develop and melt specific alloys and convert them into wire, strip, tubes and plates allows us to offer heating materials as well as heating elements and complete heating solutions to our customers.

Today we’re a truly global company with production units and sales offices all around the world.

Take a look at our career opportunities!

Name: WE-EF LIGHTING
Description: WE-EF is a global manufacturer of high-performance exterior luminaires renowned for outstanding engineering design and innovative optical systems. Established in 1950 in Germany, WE-EF is recognised worldwide as a leading exterior lighting specialist that provides professional lighting solutions for various applications, ranging from urban spaces to architectural projects.

Name: AHT Cooling Systems GmbH
Description: AHT is a leading company in commercial refrigeration supplying refrigeration units and systems with natural refrigerants. AHT refrigeration systems supply leading discount and supermarket chains as well as well-known manufacturers in the ice cream and beverage industry. With our headquarters in Rottenmann, Austria and production sites in China, Brazil and the USA, we are active on 4 continents worldwide. Under the umbrella of our parent company Daikin, we are part of a strong international group of companies that shares our values and ideas. A merger that will open up countless exciting career opportunities for you. You can look forward to a global working environment and attractive promotion and career change opportunities.

Name: SIRAIL
Description:
France's leading manufacturer and Europe's 2nd largest, Sirail designs, produces and integrates electrical harnesses, electrical cubicles and control panels for major European railways, as well as for the defence, energy and aeronautic industries. From design and manufacturing to maintenance and service, Sirail is a leading European specialist in wiring and complex electrical systems.

Want to learn more? Visit our new web site : www.sirailgroup.com

Name: Rigaku
Description:
Since its inception in 1951, Rigaku has been at the forefront of analytical and industrial instrumentation technology. Today, with hundreds of major innovations to their credit, the Rigaku Group of Companies are world leaders in the fields of general X-ray diffraction (XRD), thin film analysis (XRF, XRD and XRR), X-ray fluorescence spectrometry (TXRF, EDXRF and WDXRF), small angle X-ray scattering (SAXS), protein and small molecule X-ray crystallography, Raman spectroscopy, X-ray optics, semiconductor metrology (TXRF, XRF, XRD and XRR), X-ray sources, computed tomography, nondestructive testing and thermal analysis.

With Rigaku's vast understanding of X-ray and its complementary technologies as a foundation, our true strength is seen in an unparalleled willingness to collaborate with customers. By promoting partnerships, dialog, and innovation within the global scientific and industrial communities, Rigaku demonstrates a relentless commitment to providing our client markets with fully integrated solutions.

The company and its employees are dedicated to developing and supplying universities, industry, and government labs with the ultimate in customer-focused integrated solutions across a wide variety of disciplines, including structural proteomics, nanoengineering research, general purpose X-ray diffraction (XRD) and spectroscopy (XRF), materials analysis and quality assurance.

Whether supplying the tools to create better semiconductor chips, enabling drug discovery, improving production line quality, or exploring the new frontier of nanotechnology, Rigaku products and services lead with innovation.

Rigaku employs over 1,400 people worldwide in operations based in Japan, the U.S., Europe and China. We value our people. Our value comes from them. Close collaboration between our users and employees sets the direction and focus of our work, allowing us to address customers' needs and stay close to the market place.

Name: SOLUM
Description:
SOLUM is a Global Solution Provider delivering next-generation innovations in retail, energy, electronics, and healthcare.

Since spinning off from Samsung Electro-Mechanics in 2015, SOLUM has leveraged over 50 years of technological expertise to lead in diverse industries with solutions such as Newton Electronic Shelf Labels (ESL), digital signage, power modules, IoT platforms, sustainable energy systems, and smart healthcare devices.

Headquartered in South Korea, SOLUM operates over 20 sales subsidiaries and offices worldwide, including major hubs in the USA, Germany, Japan, and Mexico, with expanding presence across Europe and Asia. We also run 5 global production sites in Dongguan (China), Vinh Phuc (Vietnam), Noida (India), Chula Vista (USA), and Bekasi (Indonesia) — supporting global markets with agile manufacturing and advanced R&D capabilities.

With 566+ global patents and a workforce of which over 60% are R&D specialists, SOLUM connects tomorrow’s technologies with today’s value, creating a sustainable future.

 Learn more (Contact US)
www.solum-group.com (Corporate Website)

Name: Piller Power Systems
Description:
„Nothing protects quite like Piller“ - with this principle Piller is a world leader in power protection technology and builds electrical systems for mission-critical applications worldwide. 
Clients include many of the world's central and commercial banks, stock exchanges and other financial institutions, as well as broadcasters, airports, telecommunications networks, government departments and co-location operators. 

Founded by the German engineer Anton Piller in 1909, more than a century on Piller is No. 1 in High End Power Protection. Today the company has subsidiaries across Europe, the Americas, Asia and Australia and employs approaching 1000 people worldwide. 

In November 2016, Piller Power Systems Inc, the US subsidiary of Piller Group GmbH, acquired the assets and business of Active Power Inc, the US kinetic energy storage specialist.
Location: Osterode am Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany

Name: Spectra-Physics
Description: Spectra-Physics is a brand within the MKS Inc. Photonics Solutions division. The Spectra-Physics product portfolio consists of a broad spectrum of lasers for precision industrial and scientific research applications. Spectra-Physics products combine groundbreaking laser technologies with deep applications expertise to deliver disruptive performance and lower total cost of ownership. From the manufacturing floor and semiconductor fab to the research laboratory, Spectra-Physics lasers enhance our customers’ capabilities and productivity in the semiconductor, advanced electronics and specialty industrial markets. For more information, visit http://www.spectra-physics.com.

Name: EAO
Description:
Human Machine Interfaces. Since 1947.

EAO AG, a Swiss, family-owned company founded in 1947, has developed into one of the world’s leading manufacturers of high-quality industrial switches, complete custom HMI panels and interface systems, and specialised automotive switch systems.  

With over 600 dedicated employees, EAO has a global production and distribution network at its disposal.  EAO has production sites in Switzerland, Germany, North America and China, as well as 10 wholly owned international sales companies and distributors in over 50 countries, so we can guarantee global availability – around the world, around the clock.

Name: TQ-Group
Description:
Can technology make the world a better place? At TQ-Systems, we believe in this and are looking for people who want to do things together with us.

With more than 1,400 employees, we produce and develop electronic assemblies at ten locations in Germany, one location in Switzerland and one in Shanghai. We are active in a large number of different industries: Gas purification for ships, medical technology, the aerospace industry, the environmental and energy sector, industrial and automation technology. 

In addition to our services (TQ-E2MS), we offer our customers a comprehensive modular solution system with finished modules, such as

- Microcontroller Modules (TQ-Embedded)

- Drive Solutions for E-Bikes (TQ-Drives)

- Drive solutions for industry (TQ-Drives)

- Automation solutions (TQ automation) 

- Medical technology products (TQ-Medical) and

- Avionics Products (TQ-Aircraft-Electronics) 

Due to our high product diversity, we offer our employees the opportunity to participate in many different products and areas and thus obtain a broad, cross-sector know-how. 

But good work can only be achieved under good working conditions. For this reason, in addition to a company-owned ski hut, a kindergarten and flexible working time systems with many other offers, we ensure a balanced work-life balance.

In addition, you can expect a pleasant workplace with state-of-the-art equipment, a working atmosphere based on partnership, individual training opportunities and lots of attractive additional services, such as our in-house canteen.

Would you like to find out more about our open positions and attractive general conditions? Then visit our career website: https://www.tq-group.com/en/Career

Imprint: https://www.tq-group.com/en/Site-Notice

Name: Sécheron Hasler Group
Description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a leading global supplier of electrical and electronic safety components and solutions and traction power systems for the railway industry and also provides solutions for renewable energy, DC grid, and other industrial systems.

Headquartered in Switzerland, Sécheron Hasler Group is independent and privately-owned by a team of entrepreneurs committed to long-term sustainability through technological innovation, superior quality, and unrivalled customer service. We answer to you, our customers, first!

Our founding companies, Sécheron SA and HaslerRail AG, boast a 140-year history of innovation in the rail industry, pioneering railway technologies. Today, Sécheron Hasler Group draws on this extensive experience to develop and customize products and solutions compliant with local standards on markets worldwide.

Our Electrical Safety Solutions, Traction Power Systems and On-Board Electronics business units design and manufacture safety-critical electrical and electronic equipment for the rail, renewable energy, DC grid and other energy-intensive markets.

www.secheron.com

www.haslerrail.com

Name: APEM
Description:
Dream up your wildest HMI. We can make it happen.

At APEM, we are able to design and manufacture any Human Machine Interface, whatever your requirements may be. Our extensive experience enables us to develop unique switches, joysticks and panel solutions with our customers that meet the highest standards.
Our motto? Bringing our customers' projects to life. From the design to the production of interfaces fully customized to their needs, we do everything possible to provide products and services of the highest quality and reliability. 
Today, APEM is partner to thousands of companies throughout the world. 
Our interfaces equip all kinds of machines and off-road vehicles, which must be able to operate in the most extreme conditions.

Name: StarCharge Europe
Description:
StarCharge is a pioneer in the electric vehicle (EV) charging industry, boasting an impressive track record of delivering up to 2 million EV chargers. The company is ranked No. 1 globally in terms of cumulative sales volume over the past decade.

To cater to various scenarios, StarCharge offers a diverse range of intelligent and reliable charging and energy solutions, including AC and DC chargers, as well as residential, commercial and industrial (C&I), and grid-scale energy solutions. Additionally, StarCharge provides cloud platforms, apps, and energy management systems integrated with charging and microgrid networks.

StarCharge is committed to innovation and the evolution toward a more sustainable future.

Name: EiKO
Description:
EiKO is a commercial lighting manufacturer with nearly 50 years of history and one clear focus: empowering electrical distributors with solutions their contractor and end-user customers can rely on.
EiKO exists to make electrical distribution work better. The right commercial lighting products, stocked and ready, at prices that move.
We operate across the US, Canada, and Europe, with regional sales agencies, same-day pickup warehouses in key markets, and a support model built around the way distributors actually do business.
Who we work with:
Electrical distributors looking for a lighting line that's genuinely easy to rep and stock. Electrical contractors who need product that installs fast and performs. Lighting agencies and reps who want a manufacturer that shows up — with training, co-marketing support, and technical backup.
Our content reflects how we work: project case studies, product education built for the field, and updates on what's landing at distributor branches across North America.
If you're evaluating EiKO as a line, follow us. If you're already a partner, tag us in your installs — we want to tell your story.

Name: HIOKI EUROPE GmbH
Description:
Founded in Japan in 1935 HIOKI has since become the market leader for current sensors. The company develops leading-edge technology with maximum precision for power analysis and battery testing solutions. Today, HIOKI has around 1,000 employees worldwide and offers more than 200 main products.

HIOKI is the only test and measurement manufacturer who offers both high-end power analysers and also ring-type transducers and current clamps and current sensors from its own development and production. Name: GTM Testing and Metrology GmbH
Description:
GTM Testing and Metrology GmbH is a company in Bickenbach (Hessen, Germany). Our highly motivated and qualified employees deal with the precise measurement of physical quantities force and torque.

With over 30 years of experience in the development of force and torque transducers, transfer standards, standard machines as well as for calibration of transducers for force and torque, GTM is worldwide present.

Force and torque sensors of numerous manufacturers are referenced and calibrated by our solutions. That's why we claim with pride: "We define precision"

Our clients include many national metrology institutes and R&D centers of large international corporations and small businesses.

Our years of experience and expertise, a clear corporate focus on precision and our delivery reliability are our strengths.

The measurement of force and torque as vector quantity (e.g, Multi-Component Transducers (“multi-axis transducers”), wheel load sensors, ...)
GTM differs from many other manufacturers that capture these variables only as a scalar quantity.

GTM herefore is able to calibrate sensors vectorially. Europe's first DAkkS accredited multi-component calibration machine is located on our site in Bickenbach.

Name: HygroMatik GmbH
Description:
For 50 years HygroMatik GmbH has been successfully developing and producing isothermal and adiabatic humidification systems for worldwide distribution in over 50 countries. The medium-sized company with its headquarters in the north of Hamburg has 60+ employees. Since 01.12.2018 the company has been part of Carel Industries S.p.A.

Because only if we act responsibly and sustainably today, we can look successfully into the future.

You can find more information about the products, solutions and values of HygroMatik GmbH on our website.

Name: Infrasolid GmbH
Description:
Infrasolid’s infrared radiation sources are pulsable thermal emitters with a near black-body emittance. Based on a patented nanotechnology and a patented emitter set-up made of a high-melting metal, the free-standing monolithic radiating element and the nanostructured emitter surface offer numerous advantages in many applications.
The high, broadband emissivity results in a broadband and highly efficient emission of infrared radiation. By adapting the nanostructured surface, the emission spectrum can be influenced and adapted to specific applications. In this way, energy consumption can be reduced by not generating radiation in the unneeded wavelength ranges. The unique and patented manufacturing process allows the flexible production of different emitter area geometries and, therefore, an easy adaptation to customer-specific applications. The infrared radiators are available in an open version and in a hermetic housing.
The outstanding properties and the high miniaturization potential enable smaller, more powerful, and more effcient analysis and gas measurement devices. Growing environmental and safety awareness as well as increasing automation are creating a growing demand for reliable gas sensors and offering a wide range of application scenarios for this new infrared emitter technology, also in the consumer sector.

Name: Tigres GmbH
Description:
Plasma for perfect adhesion

We make plasma for your surfaces

TIGRES GmbH has been a leader in the field of atmospheric pressure plasma treatment since 1993. Our system solutions for activating, ultra-fine cleaning and coating surfaces are being used in the most varied industries all around the world. Many materials used in the automotive, aerospace, electrical, medical, consumer appliances, printing, textile and packaging industries are modified with our equipment before further processing.

Surface cleaning
Manufacturing processes often leave fine organic residue on surfaces. Plasma ultra-fine cleaning gets rid of the residue. The energy input splits the organic compounds, transforms them to the gas phase and sucks them into the exhaust system. It is a dry chemical process, allowing a coating to be applied immediately.

Surface activation
To be able to successfully bond, coat, print or paint polymers and metals, the surface must first meet a few requirements. It has to be very clean and has to be sufficiently active to form an adhesive bond with the coating material. Plasma pretreatment takes care of both of these requirements: The reactive plasma species transform the finest organic layers to the gas phase during ultra-fine cleaning. And with polymers, the functional groups described above are bonded to the outer-most molecular layer, the surface polarity increases and the prerequisite for adhesive bonding with the applied material is fulfilled.

Surface coating
Adding special precursors to the discharging plasma stream enables layers of customized materials to be applied to plastics and metals.

The following finishes can be applied:

Corrosion-resistant coating
Antibacterial coating
Antireflex coating
Scratch-resistant coating
Barrier coating
Adhesive coating

Test ink

Name: Sacher Lasertechnik GmbH
Description:
Corporate Information:
Sacher Lasertechnik is a well established business with more than 18 years experience in laser technology. The founder, Dr. Joachim R. Sacher is one of the pioneers of diode lasers with external cavity. The company has developed from a university spin-off to a technology leader in the field of high power tunable external cavity diode lasers. 

Intellectual Property:
Dr. Joachim Sacher was one of the first scientists who recognized the commercial potential of external cavity lasers in connection with antireflection coated diode lasers. The first successful antireflection coatings were realized as early as 1987 at Marburg University. External cavity designs followed within the next years. Key elements of the technology basis are protected by several patent families. 

The Team:
Sacher Lasertechnik is operated by an interdisciplinary research team consisting of physicists, electrical engineers, biologists – all with magna cum laude PhD or Diploma degrees. Research results are frequently presented at international conferences and published in leading industry magazines and science journals since 1989, c/f our publication summary. Up to now, Dr. Sacher has authored or co-authored a large number of articles in the field of external cavity diode lasers and their application. Due to our interdisciplinary research team, we have been able to extend this knowledge base into environmental and life science.
Location: Marburg an der Lahn, Hesse, Germany

Name: LAMpAS H2020 Project
Description: The H2020 Project LAMPAS is an initiative that will significantly increase the potential of laser structuring for the design of newly functionalized surfaces by enhancing the efficiency, flexibility, and productivity (over 1 m2/min) of the process based on the development of a high power ultra-short laser system as well as strategies and concepts for beam delivery. This will be performed by combining the outstanding characteristics of three laser technologies, being High-Average-Power Ultrafast Lasers, Direct Laser Interference Patterning, and Polygon Scanner processing. The expected results to be obtained in this project will provide the European industry with a cost effective and robust technology, capable of producing a broad range of functional surfaces on large areas at outstanding throughputs, bringing Europe a chance to lead in this key area of surface treatment. LAMPAS consortium covers the full value chain for laser surface texturing and has access to demanding markets. In addition, an in-line surface characterisation to enable rapid feedback about the target topography as well as to control surface temperature during the laser process will be included.

Name: Photonscore GmbH
Description:
Established in 2017, Photonscore GmbH specializes in simplifying single photon counting for its customers. The company's primary product, the LINCam, is a single photon counting camera notable for its 100% Fill-Factor and minimal noise. Alongside this, Photonscore offers the LINTag, a time to digital converter with sub 10ps resolution and 400MTags/s throughput, and the LINPix, a high-throughput detector capable of counting over 100MHz of photons. The range also includes lab utilities like constant threshold discriminators and signal splitters, catering to scientific research needs.

Photonscore's products are utilized across various sectors. The LINCam has impacted fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), enhancing weak signal detection in widefield microscopy. In quantum optics, it's crucial for studying phenomena like trapped ions and entangled photons. The LINTag and LINPix are instrumental in astronomical interferometry and material analysis in life sciences.

The company's global clientele includes leading universities and research institutes across Europe, the USA, UK, Switzerland, and Australia, reflecting the broad applicability of its technologies.

Photonscore's contributions to the field have been recognized with several awards. These include the 1st Prize in the Hugo-Junkers-Award 2017 for innovative applied research, and being a finalist in the German Innovation Award 2019.

Photonscore is committed to advancing photon counting technology, striving to make it more accessible and effective for a wide range of applications.

Magnetic material products are commonly used in smart home appliances, automobiles, medical equipment, electricity meters, wind energy converters, and other fields. Name: IDEX Optical Technologies
Description:
IDEX Optical Technologies, a platform of IDEX Corporation, is made up of our renowned brands Advanced Thin Films, CVI Laser Optics, CVI Infrared Optics & Melles Griot. 

We fuel the discovery of possibilities by generating unparalleled technology that helps inspire breakthrough thinking, drive innovation that touches our communities, and improves lives. As trailblazers of optics, we’re focused on the future of controlled light to identify, execute, and deliver a full spectrum of targeted end-to-end solutions. We connect deep industry knowledge and cutting-edge techniques to drive smarter decisions and unlock your business’ defining moments.

IDEX Optical Technologies is more than optics; we are partners who help make brilliant things happen.

Name: Indrivetec AG
Description:
Engineering that moves

Technology mirrors the spirit of the times. Technology shows progress. It gets things moving, provides a dynamic and it inspires you. Regardless of whether you want to put your technical ideas on paper, want to implement a concept for power electronics, drive systems or energy storage systems or whether you want to construct a roller coaster – our aim is to present you with an innovative and economical solution. When doing so, we use the best engineers, state-of-the-art software, first-rate and reliable components and the fun we get out of technology.

The Indrivetec AG company comprises a team of highly qualified lateral thinkers with a passion for engineering. The experienced team which has been working in the sectors of development, production, commissioning and servicing for over 25 years now listens precisely to what you have to say. Because you can develop customer-focussed solutions only if you understand the requirements

Name: Warmup PLC
Description:
Warmup is a diverse and energetic company with meaningful ambitions to change the way we heat our homes - creating a more sustainable future for all of us. 

We pride ourselves on delivering the best service possible to our customers and do so by having the industry’s best people on our team. Over the past 30 years, we have grown from one building to a sprawling campus in London and from a core team of less than twenty specialists into a truly global company with hundreds of employees and thousands of retail partners. 

At Warmup, we work together to achieve our goals and actively nurture the personal development of all our team members. We want to hear your career goals and discover together how best to facilitate your ambitions. Our team feels proud to work in an open and thoughtful environment where their voices can be heard. Becoming a member of the team at Warmup means being a part of an optimistic culture of togetherness and big ideas.

Established more than 30 years ago in 1994, the winner of the Queen's Award for Enterprise 2020 and operating in over 70 countries, Warmup is the world’s best-selling underfloor heating brand, offering a variety of underfloor heating systems, including hydronic (warm water) and electric systems. Warmup also design and manufacture unique smart, wifi thermostats for automatic heating control to help to cut down on energy bills effortlessly. Warmup’s extensive technical knowledge and innovative approach to underfloor heating allows both consumers and trade professionals to design the most efficient floor heating system that are the simplest to operate and use the least energy. Warmup offers the original lifetime warranties, alongside 24/7/365 technical support and uniquely the only national employed field engineer force.'

Name: Luxon LED
Description: At Luxon LED, we are constantly improving our products and our processes. Why? Because the effect counts. Since 2008, we have been developing solutions that meet the market's needs. So ones that fit the infrastructure of the facility and give a quick return on investment. We are guided by transparency in every lighting project. We want our customers to feel confident and secure. We openly discuss possible effects and savings, discuss needs, and present flexible solutions. We believe that successful cooperation is based on mutual understanding and trust.

Name: TTK
Description:
TTK is a global leader in digital liquid leak detection systems, engineering and manufacturing advanced solutions for over 35 years. Our smart sense cables detect water, hydrocarbons, acids, and the latest liquid cooling fluids used in high-density data centers.

Founded in France in 1989, TTK’s headquarters, R&D center, and manufacturing facilities are based in Paris. Our global presence spans subsidiaries and offices in London, Frankfurt, Philadelphia, Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, Ottawa, Dubai, Mumbai, Hong Kong, Singapore, and beyond. All products are made in France, certified by international standards including UL, FM, IEC, and ATEX, and trusted by tens of thousands of clients worldwide.

Our flagship FG-NET system offers real-time leak location accuracy (±1m), full compatibility with all TTK cables, BMS/SCADA integration, and a 7” touchscreen interface—delivering comprehensive protection for data centers, critical facilities, and commercial infrastructure.

As specialized manufacturers, we deliver tailored, reliable solutions—aligned with your project, budget, and timeline.

Name: Hioki E.E. Corporation
Description: Established in 1935, HIOKI E.E. CORPORATION (TSE: 6866) has grown to become a world leader in providing consistent delivery of test and measuring instruments through advanced design, manufacturing, and sales and services. By offering over 200 main products characterized by safety and quality while meeting an expansive range of applications, we aim to contribute to the efficiency and value of our customers’ work in research and development, production and electrical maintenance. HIOKI products and services are available around the world through our extensive network of subsidiaries and distributors. Information about HIOKI is available at www.hioki.com.

Name: Yamaichi Electronics Deutschland GmbH
Description:
Yamaichi Electronics is an internationally renowned electronics company; we are a leading designer and manufacturer of electro-mechanical components. Supplying innovative products to the semiconductor, telecom and industrial sectors, we belong to one of the biggest connector manufactures in the world.

WORKING AT YAMAICHI ELECTRONICS
We offer our employees flat hierarchies, plenty of independent responsibility and a very good working atmosphere. We offer numerous starting and career opportunities for a variety of career groups.

Yamaichi Electronics was named a top employer for engineers again this year. That puts us at the top in terms of employers for engineers.

Imprint: https://www.yamaichi.de/imprint
Privacy Policy: https://www.yamaichi.de/privacy-policy
Location: Frankfurt an der Oder, Brandenburg, Germany

Name: E+E Elektronik
Description:
E+E Elektronik develops and manufactures sensors and transmitters for humidity, dew point, moisture in oil, CO2, air velocity, mass flow, temperature and pressure. Hand-held meters, humidity calibration systems and calibration services complete the comprehensive product portfolio of the Austrian sensor specialist.  

The main areas of application are HVAC and building technology, industrial measurement technology, the automotive industry, pharmaceutical and food industry, cleanroom technology, meteorology, environmental technology and agricultural engineering.

E+E Elektronik has subsidiaries in China, Germany, France, Italy, Korea, USA and India and is represented by over 60 sales partners worldwide.

As a company with a firm commitment to quality, E+E Elektronik has an established and certified quality management system in accordance with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949. E+E also places great value on environmental protection and is therefore certified in accordance with environmental standard ISO 14001 and has been a partner of the Climate Alliance Austria for many years.
 
E+E Elektronik is accredited as a calibration laboratory according to EN ISO/IEC 17025 with the identification number 0608 by Akkreditierung Austria / Federal Ministry for Digital and Economic Affairs. The services of the accredited laboratory include manufacturer-independent calibrations of measuring instruments for the measurands humidity, dew point, CO2, air velocity, air flow, temperature and pressure.

Furthermore, E+E Elektronik has been appointed by the Federal Office of Metrology and Surveying (BEV) to maintain as designated institute the national standards for humidity, dew point, air velocity and gas concentration CO2 in Austria.

Name: United Electronic Industries
Description: UEI’s family of rugged chassis and extensive selection of over 90 I/O boards dominates the simulation, test and data acquisition markets in aerospace, defense, industrial and transportation applications. UEI’s customers include tier 1 aerospace, defense, space and industrial companies, and all branches of the military. UEI’s world class customer support and service enable rapid customer deployment and seamless integration into virtually any popular software environment including LabVIEW, Simulink/MATLAB, .NET, Java as well as C/C++.

Name: VDE Testing and Certification Institute
Description: The VDE mark is synonymous with safety and quality in electrical devices, components and systems for more than 100 years. The VDE Institute—a subsidiary of the VDE Group— is a worldwide partner for industry customers, business, government authorities, the electrical trade and consumers. . More than 100,000 devices per year are subjected to product, quality and safety tests by the VDE Institute’s independent testing engineers before they receive the VDE mark. Around the globe, VDE experts monitor more than 7,000 production facilities. Cooperation agreements with more than 50 countries ensure that the tests performed by the VDE Institute are internationally recognized. 200,000 types of products with millions of model variants bear the VDE mark worldwide. The VDE Testing and Certification Institute GmbH, a non-profit organization, employs more than 500 people in Offenbach am Main.

Name: Triathlon Group
Description:
The Triathlon Group is a globally operating and well positioned provider of products and services for efficient battery and energy solutions. Our focus is on the application areas of electromobility and stationary systems. The core business includes the development, production and sale of high-quality, powerful battery and charging technology products for industrial applications. The specialized services bundled in the group as well as its regional structure enable TRIATHLON to be extremely close to its customers and to offer solutions for almost any requirement. The group employs more than 1,000 people and is headquartered in Fürth with central production sites in Glauchau and Freiberg. TRIATHLON is represented internationally with sales and production sites in the USA, UK, Australia and France, among others.

Legal notes: https://www.triathlon-batterien.de/en/copyright-menu/data-privacy

Name: First Sensor
Description:
As a part of TE Connectivity our company develops and produces sensors and customized sensor solutions for applications in the industrial, medical and mobility segments. Our customers include both renowned corporations and fledgling technology companies that rely on our innovative products and expertise. We work together to turn visions such as Industry 4.0, e-health and autonomous driving into reality.

A crucial advantage of First Sensor is our ability to handle the entire value chain in sensor technology, from the wafer to the smart sensor system. We also have the in-house technologies needed to combine the properties of materials and components in innovative ways as part of sophisticated processes. Our specialists are committed to researching all aspects of high-quality sensor systems, allowing them to continually spur innovation and make it a reality. This acts as an ideal platform on which to realize high-performance projects and thus consolidate our market leadership.

The expertise and dedication of our 1,000 employees who work at sales and production sites all over the world – in Germany, the Netherlands, UK, France, Sweden, Denmark, US, Canada and China – are the foundations on which our success is based.

To ensure that we can continue developing top-quality customized products for our customers well into the future, we are looking to bring innovative minds on board to help us shape the future. We will give you responsibility and freedom – not only for your ideas, but also for our mutual development.

Name: FEIG ELECTRONIC
Description:
FEIG ELECTRONIC is a leading global supplier of RFID & barcode systems, unattended payment terminals, gate and barrier control systems as well as induction loop detectors.
With more than 50 years of industry experience, FEIG delivers RFID readers and antennas for all standard operating frequencies to be used in several authentication and identification solutions.
cVEND Payment terminals from FEIG support numerous international debit & credit cards, mobile payment applications such as Google Pay or Apple Pay as well as various closed loop systems for applications in public transport, EV charging, parking and vending.
Door control units from FEIG are the intelligent core of industrial doors as well as barriers and bollards. They ensure safe and reliable operation and control any connected accessories, too.
Induction loop detectors are the key component for controlling traffic lights, counting traffic and actively managing traffic.

Name: Audio-Technica Distributed Brands Europe
Description:
Established in Japan in 1962, Audio-Technica is dedicated to creating meaningful connections through sound via its microphones, headphones, wireless systems, mixers and turntables. From providing mics for the world’s largest sporting events, to supplying mixers for government buildings across the world, Audio-Technica never stops in its quest to pursue the highest quality sound for all.
 
As part of this pursual, Audio-Technica has collaborated with some of the world’s leading audio companies to create Audio-Technica Distribution, the go-to place for solutions-focused audio equipment. 
 
In Europe, Audio-Technica’s offices are located in France, Germany, the UK, Spain, the Netherlands and Hungary. These offices support the sales, logistics and marketing needs of EMEA and an extensive network of sales partners are supplied from the logistics centers in the Netherlands, the UK and Spain. These offices are all helping to provide one-stop-audio-solutions for EMEA, with an array of audio brands on offer.

Name: Midea Deutschland
Description:
Midea Europe GmbH ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Midea Group und konzentriert sich auf Haushaltsgeräte und Klimaanlagen im deutschsprachigen und nordeuropäischen Raum. Die Midea Group ist ein weltweit führendes Technologieunternehmen mit fünf Geschäftsbereichen: Smart Home Business, Industrie- und Gebäudetechnologien, Robotik und Automatisierung sowie digitale Innovation. Die Gruppe hat in den letzten sechs Jahren mehr als 10 Milliarden US-Dollar in Forschung und Entwicklung investiert und verfügt über ein globales Netzwerk mit 38 Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentren und 40 großen Produktionsstandorten weltweit. Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen der Midea Group bereichern das Leben von Milliarden Menschen in über 200 Ländern und Regionen und umfassen ein Markenportfolio mit mehreren Marken wie Midea, Comfee, Toshiba, Clivet, Eureka, KUKA, Welling und weitere.  

Die Midea Group beschäftigt rund 200.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit und rangiert im Jahr 2025 auf Platz 246 der Global Fortune 500. Das Unternehmen verfügt über ein Kreditrating von A/A3/A von S&P, Moody’s bzw. Fitch und legt einen starken Fokus auf Technologieführerschaft und Innovation. Die Midea Europe GmbH ist seit 2005 die europäische Tochter der Midea Group mit Sitz in Eschborn bei Frankfurt und beschäftigt ca. 100 Mitarbeiter in den Bereichen Verkauf, Marketing, Kundendienst, Produkt, Logistik und Finanzen. Das eigene Research & Development Center in Stuttgart beschäftigt täglich über 60 Ingenieure, die an der Entwicklung von Produkten für zufriedene Kunden in Deutschland und Europa arbeiten.  

Die Midea Group baut ihre Führungsposition im Bereich Smart Home und Smart Manufacturing durch kontinuierliche Investitionen in Technologieführerschaft, Direktvertrieb, digitale Intelligenz und globale Durchbrüche aus. Das Unternehmen bietet attraktive Wachstumsmöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen, globalen Umfeld und fördert Talente.

Name: Roland Professional A/V

Roland Pro A/V, a division of the Roland Corporation, is dedicated to providing solutions in support of audio and video professionals demanding excellence in both performance and functionality.

Through the development and support of video and audio products, we endeavor to improve workflow and maximize creative possibilities in a variety of markets.

Markets we serve include: 

Broadcast • Education • Live Production • Theatre • Videography • Visual Performance • House of Worship

Description: With more than 30 years of experience Innovative Sensor Technology IST AG is one of the leading manufacturers of physical, chemical and biological sensors. iST specializes in the development and manufacturing of thin- and thick-film platinum and nickel RTD temperature sensors, thermal mass flow sensors, capacitive humidity sensors, conductivity sensors and biosensors. Name: CalcuQuote
Description: CalcuQuote delivers supply chain software built for electronics manufacturing. The platform provides operational intelligence for EMS providers, OEMs, and suppliers across sourcing, purchasing, and quoting in a single, connected system. With real-time supply data and seamless system integrations, CalcuQuote increases visibility, speed, and control across the entire supply chain. Name: LG Electronics Deutschland
Description:
Life's Good
 
Wir bei LG Electronics glauben, dass ein gutes Leben darin besteht, alle kostbaren Momente in vollen Zügen zu genießen. 
 
Unsere Philosophie dreht sich um Menschen, Aufrichtigkeit und die Besinnung auf das Wesentliche. Es geht darum, Menschen durch moderne Produkte, attraktives Design und smarte Innovationen ein Lächeln aufs Gesicht zu zaubern.
Seit der Gründung des Unternehmens im Jahre 1958 ist es unser Ziel, das Leben und den Lebensstil unserer Kund:innen durch intelligente Produktfunktionen, intuitive Funktionalität und außergewöhnliche Leistung zu verbessern. Wir stellen intuitive, energiesparende und innovative Verbraucherelektronik her, die neue Maßstäbe setzt. Von TV-Geräten über Monitore bis hin zu Klimaanlagen, Waschmaschinen und mehr – unsere breite Produktpalette überzeugt durch Bedienkomfort, intelligente Technologien, exzellentes Design und einen niedrigen Energieverbrauch.
 
Mit über 140 Niederlassungen und 750.000 Mitarbeiter:innen weltweit sind wir global führender Anbieter und technologischer Impulsgeber in den Bereichen Unterhaltungselektronik und Haushaltsgeräte. Unsere Unternehmensführung folgt den Grundsätzen des „Jeong-do Management“. Verankert in den Prinzipien der „Customer-Value Creation“ und des „People-Oriented Management“ prägen diese Werte unsere Unternehmenskultur und fördern Kreativität, Vielfalt sowie Integrität. Bei LG glauben wir an die Kraft der kollektiven Weisheit und schaffen ein kollaboratives Arbeitsumfeld.
 
Wir schätzen unsere Mitarbeiter:innen als den wichtigsten Faktor unseres Erfolges. Deshalb legen wir Wert auf eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima.

Schließe dich uns an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das nicht nur Lösungen für ein besseres Leben schafft – bei LG ist das Leben einfach gut.

Name: Pfannenberg
Description:
Our employees at 10 locations all over the world are always committed to our customers and their needs in everything they do. We strive to build and maintain trusting and cooperative relationships - and have done so since our foundation in 1954. 

Pfannenberg is a medium-sized, family-run company. Our expertise in our core competences of enclosure cooling, process cooling and visual and audible signaling makes us your reliable partner. 

Out of respect for our environment, we are particularly engaged in designing energy efficient and sustainable products. High quality standards are a matter of course for us.

Description:
Providing world-class consulting services, product solutions, and after-sales support during the entire transformer lifecycle.
