Name: ESYLUX
Description:
ESYLUX develops, manufactures and distributes intelligent automation and lighting solutions that ensure better quality of life and energy efficiency in office buildings, educational institutions and health facilities. People's requirements and needs are central to what we do. To meet this standard, we use our experience in electronics and automation for development in areas such as LED-based systems for energy-efficient, biologically effective light. The perspective ranges from the comprehensive automation and lighting of the individual room to networking and integration into building-wide systems. In view of the often complex requirements we encounter in the process, we place particular value on the simple application of our product solutions.

Our customers and partners are wholesalers, installation companies, electrical and lighting planners and architects who trust our 50 years of market experience and the personal specialist advice our experts provide. Furthermore, we meet the highest quality standards in our research, development and production at our German location in Ahrensburg. Our sales organisation is global: ESYLUX operates in collaboration with experienced trading partners and is represented by a lot of subsidiaries in Europe, Asia and Oceania.

Name: Ark Vision Systems GmbH & Co. KG
Description: Our vision is to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of our customers through our products. We develop and produce robust, digital camera sensor systems, which are particularly suitable for use in harsh environments. In addition to the hardware, we develop our own as well as customer-specific software applications based on artificial intelligence (AI). As a manufacturer, we pay attention to modern production and logistics structures according to the guidelines of "Lean Production" and follow the high quality standard according to DIN EN ISO 9001. In order to meet our quality standards, we rely on "Made in Germany" in both development and production.

Name: Faber Group
Description:
Besides cables and wires for the energy sector, Faber Group offers innovative system solutions in the fields of cranes and hoisting equipment, mining, telecommunications and data cables, infrastructure/PV and maritime cable logistics. Our standout products include preassembled systems for various industrial applications, a wide range of fibre-optic cables and components for broadband, cloud and data centre and 5G network expansion, as well as photovoltaic solutions. Our subsidiary Friesland Kabel GmbH markets marine cables and customised systems for the maritime sector. ZIEGLER ENGINEERING GmbH, which has been part of the Faber Group since the end of 2022, specializes in the sale and project-related development of turnkey solutions in the areas of heating and measurement technology.

The number of employees at five locations in Germany – Saarland, Baden-Württemberg Lower Saxony, Schleswig-Holstein and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania already exceeds 300 at this point in time. Be it for trainees, dual students, career starters or professionals – Faber offers attractive entry and development opportunities.  

Faber stands for jobs with perspectives and long-term, successful partnerships. Flat hierarchies, flexible structures, short decision-making and communication paths, individual responsibility, room for personal development, team spirit and a good working atmosphere are important to us. Interested?

Name: RAEDIAN
Description:
At Raedian, we're not just another electric vehicle charging brand – we're innovators at the forefront of sustainable transportation. 

Our comprehensive approach covers the entire spectrum, from research and development to manufacturing, overseas sales, and localization services. We specialize in integrating "intelligent hardware + software + service" to create a core threshold that defines our commitment to excellence. Comprising senior experts R&D team boasts extensive experience in software, hardware, and application development.

Our product philosophy revolves around product excellence, technological innovation, and a commitment to prioritizing service. 

Having successfully shipped and deployed over 1 million units globally in the electric vehicle charging sector, our seasoned team forms the backbone of our dedication to delivering high-quality, reliable, and innovative charging solutions.

Join us on this transformative journey towards a greener and more connected world. Welcome to Raedian – where the future of electric vehicle charging begins.

Name: SIEB & MEYER AG
Description:
SIEB & MEYER was founded in 1962 and has been an internationally successful company in the field of industrial electronics since then. With around 450 employees we develop and manufacture control and drive technology. Our product range includes controllers for the machine construction and automation technology, servo amplifiers for various drives, frequency converters for high-speed motors and generators.

We also have a lot to offer as an employer: Our employees are a team of experienced experts and young talents who are motivated and contribute to the company's success. Long-term development perspectives, a versatile field of work, a modern infrastructure and attractive terms of work - all this awaits you at SIEB & MEYER!

Name: BUCK Lighting
Description:
BUCK is a lighting specialist founded in 1992. With R&D in Austria, Germany, Switzerland and Serbia, and production plant in Serbia, our products are a combination of innovation, high quality, and good performance. BUCK offers lighting consultancies in the field of lighting design, ROI calculations based on energy efficiency, especially in smart buildings and outdoor illumination.
The experience acquired pushes us to create an innovative product, compliant with all European norms and safety standards. The product that is easily integrated into all types of interiors and exteriors both by function and by aesthetics, easy for mounting and maintenance, pleasing to the end-user. Over a dozen international awards for exceptional industrial, graphic and architectural design (IF, RedDot, Good Design, Iconic, German Design).
A long list of reference projects in over 45 countries, some of the world's most renowned brands in the client list, Ernst& Young Entrepreneur of the Year award 2012 state the transparency and quality of BUCK’s value chain.

In January 2020, BUCK is launching a new brand label BUDEC. BUDEC is created for the EU market only, where there is a need for distinction regarding the architectural lighting range. It has been established to separate the architectural from the technical component that BUCK nourishes in their product portfolio of medical, sport, street and industrial lighting.
BUDEC products will continue the legacy of high- quality products with top of the class optical performances. All other product ranges will still be available under the BUCK brand.
New website and additional information are coming soon.

Name: EAS Batteries GmbH
Description:
For more than 20 years, EAS has played an essential role in the battery industry with high power solution and innovative manufacturing technologies. 
EAS is powering some of the boldest projects of our time and offers tailor-made heavy duty, high power and high energy cylindrical Lithium-ion cells from 7.5 Ah up to 50 Ah.
On the road to success, EAS ensures its clients receive the best solutions through cell consulting, battery consulting, materials development, custom cell design, custom cell manufacturing and custom battery design.
Its innovative solutions and high quality are result of a German manufacturing expertise. The ultimate aim is to achieve innovative power-management perfection, crafted for the individual needs of industry clients coming from marine, space, defense, public transportation, commercial fleet, construction and many others where high quality and high safety are essential.

Name: Hirose Electric Europe B.V.
Description:
HIROSE Electric is a world-class Japanese manufacturer of high quality connectors that are sold across all global markets in the electronics industry. 

Since the establishment of Hirose in 1937, an excellent reputation has been built through the production of technically advanced connectors that incorporate the latest cutting-edge technology. As a result, the functions and performance of Hirose connectors are more diversified and sophisticated to satisfy the growing demand for smaller, highly innovative connectors that provide superior connectivity. 

Such innovations include; enhanced locking mechanisms, ultra low height profiles, high retention forces, user friendly assembly, high speed transmission, high contact reliability and many others. 
Hirose complies with ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO/TS16949, ISO/IEC17025.

A wide product portfolio of over 50,000 connectors variations are available. These include wire to board, board to board, circular, memory, interface, FFC/FPC and coaxial connectors. These are suitable for a wide range of applications such as; factory automation, industrial machinery, LED lighting, broadcasting, measurement & control, security devices, instrumentation, consumer electronics, automotive and many more.

Hirose Electric Europe B.V, the European division of Hirose Electric Co., Ltd, has expanded its European network by increasing the number of sales offices.  In addition to the European Headquarters based in The Netherlands, six more offices are now present; three are in Germany and the remainder are in the UK, France and Finland to provide a higher level of local customer service.

To find out more about the Hirose office locations or new product developments, please contact Hirose below:

Email: eu.info.3d@hirose-gl.com
Web: www.hirose.com/eu

Name: LAP Laser
Description:
LAP is one of the world's leading suppliers of systems that increase quality and efficiency through laser projection, laser measurement, and other processes.

Every year, LAP supplies 15,000 units to customers in industries as diverse as radiation therapy, steel production, and composite processing. With 300 employees at 8 locations in Europe, America, and Asia, LAP generated a turnover in 2025 of €69.6 million.

We help our customers save costs through quality improvements and increased process efficiency. The investment in our products often pays for itself after only a few months. 

We know that precision and quality are essential for our customers, and we want our products to be easy to integrate and operate. We thus reduce complexity and our customers can concentrate on their actual core process. This is the true meaning of “Simply Precise”.
  
Customers worldwide appreciate the high quality of our products and the outstanding technical service provided by our locations and a global network of certified partners.

Follow us for the latest news and upcoming events worldwide and be a part of our story.

#simplyprecise #laplaser

Name: Parvalux Electric Motors
Description:
Parvalux is the UK's largest manufacturer of fractional horsepower electric motors and gearboxes. With over 20 million units installed globally, we are proud to be a maxon company and of our continued reputation for innovation, quality and value for money.

A considerable program of investment into machines, infrastructure and people is helping our customers to gain genuine competitive advantage in their markets.

Parvalux benefits from strong distribution partnerships across the globe. Over 50% of products are exported, with production now exceeding 275,000 units annually.

As well as a standard catalogue offer of over 5,000 product variants, Parvalux offers a fully bespoke geared motor design service for larger volume OEMs.  With more than twenty design engineers, Parvalux has made a serious investment in its capability to produce innovative designs to short timescales.

Parvalux now enjoys a reputation as a specialist supplier to numerous industry sectors, including: healthcare, mobility, leisure, farming, automotive and industrial automation.

For larger OEM projects, our team of highly experienced engineers ensures our value-add right from the outset of any project.

For UK SME customers, our state-of-the-art Service Centre in Birmingham holds extensive stock at a central location and provides a rapid response capability.
Location: Rod an der Weil, Hesse, Germany

Name: Gustav Hensel GmbH & Co. KG
Description: Mit über 1.000 Beschäftigten, davon 640 in Deutschland, 13 Tochtergesellschaften im In- und Ausland, agieren wir seit über 90 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt. Das ist die Gustav Hensel GmbH und Co. KG aus Lennestadt-Altenhundem. Das marktführende Unternehmen sorgt mit seinen Produkten und Services für die sichere Verteilung von elektrischer Energie in Industrie, Gewerbe und Infrastruktur. Name: Fuji Electric Europe - Drives & Automation

Name: Klippel GmbH
Description:
KLIPPEL is an innovative leader in providing unique test equipment for electro-acoustical transducers and audio systems. Founded in 1997 by Dr. Wolfgang Klippel, the novel techniques developed for control and measurement systems of loudspeakers and other transducers are the result of over 30 years of fundamental research. This provides more accurate physical models of loudspeakers, micro-speakers and headphones valid for both small and large amplitudes. The focus is on revealing the root causes of signal distortion and defects and giving practical indications for improvements in design and manufacturing of audio products.

KLIPPEL offers a broad portfolio of products and services. The main products are the KLIPPEL Analyzer System with the R&D applications and QC System (End-of-Line Testing) and the KLIPPEL CONTROLLED SOUND TECHNOLOGY. These cutting-edge technologies have changed the way loudspeakers are developed and manufactured in the audio industry.

The KLIPPEL Analyzer System empowers engineers around the globe in creating, evaluating and testing audio products over the full life cycle in the lab, on the production line and in the field. Based on a common hard- and software platform, these tools allow products to be created that exceed the end-user’s expectations while minimizing manufacturing costs. KLIPPEL‘s vast research on acoustics, loudspeaker modeling and system identification is the basis for unique measurement and simulation tools as well as innovative DSP algorithms.

The KLIPPEL CONTROLLED SOUND TECHNOLGY (KCS) stands for a new paradigm in active loudspeaker control and correction. The adaptive control structure is based on electro-acoustical modeling and combines real-time monitoring of the transducer parameters with active protection against thermal and mechanical overload, nonlinear distortion cancellation, system alignment and stabilization of the voice coil position.

Description:

Motec is a unit of AMETEK Inc. a leading global manufacturer of electronic instruments and electromechanical products.

Name: EPTechnologies
Description:
EPTechnologies is a complete marine propulsion provider for electric and hybrid vessels. We guide the customers through the process of turning dreams into real hybrid and electric vessels with the use of the finest quality that makes economical sense.

With us you get all out of one hand, from our in-house lithium-ion batteries, DC-generators and sail /shaft or Z / Jet drives and it’s  all controlled by our own truster control and EMS / PMS software systems. 

As long-time sailors and boat owners we are aware of the problems that can occur on a daily basis.  Therefore, we create systems designed with backup options and constructing them to be as simple as possible. For big systems with parallel strings we have double communication lines and double system controllers with back up functions.

If there is something we can’t do in-house, we use our extensive network and highly competent partners to find the right solutions.

We design and manufacture Lithium NCM and LFP batteries 24-800 VDC. EPT lithium batteries are available in two technologies, 12 VDC in LiFePO4 and 24&48 VDC in NMC, with a nominal capacity from 52 to 150 Ah (2-2.8 kWh). All batteries comes in the same size. Right now, we believe we have the lightest and safest batteries used in the marine industry. We are working on a life-cycle strategy for the lithium batteries as recycling is a part of our future strategy. 

To be able to control the vessels remotely we acquired the App BoatControl. This App is easy to install, adaptable to the individual vessel and is intuitive to operate.  

EPTechnologies also manufacture electric outboard motors with a range from 50HP to 400HP. They are easy to operate, exceptional performance and with high security standards. We also put emphasis on making it a good-looker.

Our years of experience, quality, innovation and durability is a guarantee for a stress-free drive / sailing experience. We stand by our service!

Developers and programmers of software solutions

This enables the simple, secure and scalable networking of physical objects such as IoT transmission units for tank and object monitoring and of PC-based systems.

Geschichte

Experts Electronics wurde in einem kleinen Büro gegründet, angetrieben von der Leidenschaft und Vision eines Teams von Fachleuten, die einen bedeutenden Beitrag zur Welt der Elektronik leisten wollten. Im Laufe der Jahre, dank einer Kombination von hochmodernen technischen Fähigkeiten und einem kundenorientierten Ansatz, hat das Unternehmen seine Größe und seinen Ruf als Branchenführer gefestigt.

Unsere Dienstleistungen

Bei Experts Electronics bieten wir ein vollständiges Spektrum an Dienstleistungen im Bereich Elektronikdesign:

Machbarkeitsstudien: Bevor wir ein Projekt beginnen, führen wir gründliche Untersuchungen durch, um dessen technische und wirtschaftliche Machbarkeit zu bewerten.

Leiterplattendesign (PCB): Mit unserer Expertise und fortschrittlichen Simulationswerkzeugen können wir komplexe Leiterplatten entwerfen, die den spezifischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden entsprechen.

Prototypenbau: Nach Abschluss des Designs produzieren wir Prototypen für Tests und Validierung. Diese Prototypen werden strengen Tests unterzogen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den höchsten Standards entsprechen.

Serienfertigung: Nach der Validierung des Prototyps begleiten wir unsere Kunden bei der Serienproduktion und stellen sicher, dass jede Einheit den Spezifikationen entspricht.

Nachbetreuung: Unsere Beziehung zu unseren Kunden endet nicht mit der Einführung des Produkts. Wir bieten kontinuierliche Unterstützung, um sicherzustellen, dass das Produkt aktuell bleibt und einwandfrei funktioniert.

Description:
Sie brauchen kundenspezifische Kabel oder Baugruppen — aber der direkte Einkauf in Asien-Lieferanten bedeutet Sprachbarriere, Zollabwicklung und die Frage, wer eigentlich haftet, wenn etwas schiefgeht.

Genau da setze ich als deutscher Ansprechpartner an. Wagener Systems GmbH ist Ihr Vertragspartner nach deutschem Recht — die Fertigung übernimmt unsere Partnerfirma in Thailand, unter deutscher Führung und europäischen Qualitätsansprüchen. Sie bestellen bei mir, ich liefere ab Lager Wunstorf per Standard-Paketdienst. Kein Import, kein Zoll, kein Behördenkram auf Ihrer Seite.

Unsere Fertigung ist IATF 16949 zertifiziert, jedes Kabel wird zu 100% geprüft. Mit eigenentwickelten Makromelt-Spritzgussmaschinen und internem Werkzeugbau lösen wir auch Spezialfälle, für die andere zu groß oder zu unflexibel sind — ohne dass Sie dafür Stückzahlen im Hunderttausender-Bereich mitbringen müssen.

Ein Beispiel: Ein Medizintechnik-Kunde brauchte einen Schukostecker, der sicher hält, aber keine Spannung führen darf. Wir haben die leitenden Kontaktstifte durch eigens gefertigte Kunststoffstifte ersetzt — Halt gesichert, Stromleitung ausgeschlossen. Der Kunde konnte sein Gerät sicher ausliefern.

Seit 2008 arbeite ich so mit rund 50 Kunden aus Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik, Robotik, Luftfahrt und EMS — auf Augenhöhe, mit offenem Ohr auch dann, wenn mal etwas nicht rundläuft.

Haben Sie eine Zeichnung und eine reelle Stückzahl im Kopf? Schreiben Sie mir eine Nachricht oder eine E-Mail — ich melde mich umgehend und persönlich.

Name: GAUSS INSTRUMENTS
Description: GAUSS INSTRUMENTS traces its technical roots to basic research on short time Fourier analysis and synthesis begun in the 70’s. The TDEMI Technology is a registered brand and patented technology of GAUSS INSTRUMENTS. It is provided to you only by GAUSS or its’ official certified local partners. Joint research projects were performed in the field of time-domain measurements of electromagnetic interferences (EMI) together with well-respected research institutes and universities. Official metrology labs, testing and certification institutes, as well as leading automotive OEMs and many other blue chip companies selected GAUSS as innovative cooperation partner and reliable solution provider for their demanding test requirements during market certification as well as product development but also research investigations. Over the past two decades about 100 publications, transaction papers, white papers and journal articles were published on selected topics of time-domain EMI measurements and EMC testing as well as intelligent methods for automated testing. As inventor of the TDEMI Measurement Systems which use ultra high-speed analog-to-digital converters and pretty much advanced real-time digital signal processing methods we enable ultra fast tests and measurements for electromagnetic compliance that fulfill the increasing demands for measurements of today’s ever increasing density and complexity of electronic equipment and systems

Description:

Moreover, bh introduced a multi-dimensional TCSPC process that records the photons not only versus the time in the signal period, but also versus other parameters, such as experiment time, wavelength, or spatial coordinates. The bh devices are designed to record multi-dimensional photon distributions, time-resolved images, sequences of photon distributions, or multi-dimensional time-tag data. The bh TCSPC products are complemented by bh picosecond diode lasers, detector modules, multi-spectral detector assemblies, and experiment control modules. DC Power Supplies
A power supply is often taken for granted as it is seen as an insignificant part of equipment. For most it is just an electronic box ordered at the last moment. However, a power supply can be compared to our heart; It’s often neglected and we tend to pay more attention to our hair. Yet if the heart fails, the system goes down.

Design concept
Delta power supplies have a reputation of being remarkably reliable. Therefore our design concept puts a strong emphasis on long lifetime and excellent technical specifications. The specifications of our products may seem unrealistic at first, but when measured they turn out to be even better as defined. Delta users expect perfection, an almost infinite life time at continuous full power and low cost of ownership. Ongoing research makes it possible to produce products that can meet these ever increasing demands.

Result
As a result of our design philosophy the units react more than 10 times faster on load transients, produce hardly audible noise and produce 10 – 30 times less electromagnetic interference. Delta customers will never face any problems due to radiated or conducted emissions of our power supplies. The same design philosophy applies for immunity: the toughest standard is not good enough for us. A Delta power supply will always operate reliable, even in a very noisy environment.All our power supply units are thoroughly tested before being dispatched to the customer.This ensures long term correct functioning of each unit and client satisfaction. Delta Elektronika produces world class DC power supplies.

Name: Bruker Optics
Description:
Bruker Optics manufactures and distributes research, analytical and process analysis instruments based on infrared (IR), near-infrared (NIR), FT-Raman and dispersive Raman Spectroscopy. These products are utilized in industry, government and academia for a wide range of applications and solutions for life science, pharmaceutical analysis, food and agricultural analysis in research and development, quality control and process analysis applications. As with all spectroscopic techniques, vibrational spectroscopy can be used to identify a compound and to investigate the composition of a sample. Bruker Optics utilizes Fourier Transform (FT-IR, FT-NIR and FT-Raman) and the dispersive Raman measurement techniques on an extensive range of laboratory and process spectrometers. Infrared spectroscopy is a type of absorption spectroscopy that uses the infrared part of the electromagnetic spectrum. Raman spectroscopy relies on the Raman scattering of a monochromatic light that yields similar and complementary analytical information. Infrared and Raman spectroscopy are widely used in both research and industry as a simple, rapid, non-destructive and reliable technique for applications ranging from basic sample identification and quality control to advanced research. The Bruker Optics product line is complemented by a wide range of sampling accessories and techniques which include microanalysis, high-throughput screening and many others, to help users find suitable solutions to analyze their samples effectively.

Although headquartered in Sweden, our four divisions: Pattern Generators, PCB Assembly Solutions, Assembly Solutions High Volume and Global Technologies makes us a global organization; with subsidiaries, agents and distributors in more than 50 countries. This enables us to combine deep market insight with fast, reliable support, helping our customers achieve efficient production. 

At Mycronic, diversity is more than a value — it’s our strength. Being a company built on passion, collaboration and outside-the-box thinking, a diverse workforce and inclusive culture fuels innovation and strengthens our connection to customers and the various in which we operate. Quite simply, our diversity is our competitive edge. 
Electronics touch every corner of our lives. Through our technological expertise, innovative spirit and passionate teamwork, we help make the world smarter, brighter and more sustainable, for people everywhere, every day. Together with our customers, we are committed to extending the frontiers of of electronics technology. Because with each breakthrough, the impossible becomes possible. Our mission is clear: to bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.

Name: ALPS ALPINE
Description:
Alps Alpine, a leading manufacturer of electronic components and automotive infotainment systems, has brought the world numerous “First 1” and “Number 1” products since its founding in 1948. The Alps Alpine Group currently operates 110 bases in 26 countries and regions, supplying roughly 40,000 different products and solutions to around 2,000 companies worldwide. 

In January 2019, Alps Electric Co., Ltd. and Alpine Electronics, Inc. integrated their businesses to embark on a new era as Alps Alpine Co., Ltd. Serving a diverse range of markets encompassing an automotive industry currently undergoing major transformation, the mobile and consumer electronics domains, through to energy, healthcare and industry markets, Alps Alpine will combine and build on core device technology established over many years in three areas – human-machine interfaces, SENSORINGTM and connectivity – along with system design and software development capabilities to innovate value that brings comfort to and enriches the lives of people everywhere.

Name: MENNEKES
Description:
Welcome! Founded in 1935, our family-owned company is a leading manufacturer of industrial #plugs, connectors and #emobility charging solutions. #MENNEKES is managed by the third generation of the family. Our company is active in over 90 countries with subsidiaries and representatives. Around 1,600 employees are working for us.

We are producing plugs, connectors, receptacles and receptacle combinations in a wide variety of designs. Our robust, durable solutions are used wherever electricity needs to flow safely and stably - for example in various industrial sectors, in tunnels and at railway stations, in mining and shipbuilding, in container ports, data centres, wind parks, for fire brigades and disaster control and at events of all kinds.

In the field of electromobility MENNEKES offers clever solutions and the infrastructure for the mobility of the future. Since 2014 our ‘Type 2’ charging plug has been the standard for electric vehicles throughout Europe by EU law. Our range includes charging cables with ‘Type 2’ plugs, intelligent charging stations and wallboxes as well as suitable software solutions including billing services and a trained partner network - for homes, industry, commerce and public car parks in municipalities. For the automotive industry and its suppliers we are manufacturing charging inlets and charging cables for electric cars.

We are hiring and looking for you: https://www.mennekes.org/career 

Imprint: https://www.mennekes.org/imprint

Name: IPG Photonics GmbH & Co. KG
Description:
IPG Photonics is the leading developer and manufacturer of high-performance fiber lasers and amplifiers for diverse applications in numerous markets. IPG Photonics diverse lines of low, medium and high-power lasers and amplifiers are used in materials processing, entertainment, medical, biotechnology, scientific and advanced applications. Our products are displacing traditional technologies in many current applications and enabling new applications for lasers.

The Company is leveraging its brand and position as a pioneer and leader in developing and commercializing fiber lasers and amplifiers increasing its market share in the broader markets. IPG lasers continue to displace traditional lasers in many existing applications due to their superior performance and value. Quite simply, IPG's products are disrupting the market by empowering tomorrow's applications today.

IPG's highly vertically-integrated development and manufacturing capabilities enable the Company to meet customer requirements, accelerate development, manage costs and improve component yields, while maintaining high performance and quality standards. 

IPG is a global company with manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Germany, Russia and Italy, and regional sales offices in China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, India, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Spain, Poland, Czech Republic, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The Company sells its products globally to OEMs, system integrators and end users in a wide range of diverse markets that have the in-house engineering capability to integrate IPG's products into their own systems.

Name: MVG | Microwave Vision Group
Description:
The Microwave Vision Group offers cutting-edge technologies for the visualization of electromagnetic waves. With advanced test solutions for antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements, we support company R&D teams in their drive to innovate and boost product development.

Our solutions include:

•	MV-ScanTM technology: electronically-scanned multi-probe arrays
•	Antenna, RCS, radome & EMC measurement systems
•	Turnkey anechoic chambers
•	StarMIMOTM: MIMO testing systems
•	Antennas & probes
•	Wireless device measurement & certification, including SAR & HAC
•	Measurement software
•	RF safety  monitors and other applications 
•	RF absorbers
•	EMC shielded chambers 

With highly skilled teams across the world and over 450 dedicated employees, we proudly serve the telecommunications, aerospace&defence, automotive, academic and research communities.

Over a period of more than 30 years, MVG has unified the skills of four industry leaders (Satimo, Orbit/FR, Rainford EMC, AEMI).

Together, under one unified brand, we tackle some of the world’s most complex electromagnetic wave visualisation challenges.

Name: TTI, Inc. - Europe
Description:
TTI, Inc., a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a world leading specialist distributor of passive, connector, electromechanical, discrete, power and sensor components.

TTI’s philosophy is "Lead by Design", and the company differentiates itself by focusing on people, parts and process. TTI in Europe strives to be the distributor of choice for customers and suppliers alike by introducing new product technologies and by stocking broad and deep inventory across its franchise base. 

TTI Europe is headquartered in Maisach-Gernlinden near Munich, Germany. Our purpose-built facility occupies 45,000m2, with 40,000 m2 of dedicated warehouse space, and services all European regions. Globally, TTI is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas and has over 100 locations across North America, Europe and Asia. 
 TTI’s sophisticated inventory management system ensures the ability to service changes in demand due to fluctuating markets and supply chains.

Name: FRAMOS
Description:
FRAMOS is the leading camera module design and manufacturing expert.

Founded in Munich, Germany over 40 years ago, FRAMOS has empowered companies worldwide to make drones fly safely, enable robots to see and think, make diagnostics faster and more affordable, boost athletic performance with AI, and countless other innovations.

FRAMOS stands for best-in-class image quality, an open-source approach, and fast, easy integration – helping customers launch products quicker and stay ahead of the competition.

With strong expertise in electronics design, optics and optical assembly, camera calibration, image tuning, and software integration, FRAMOS provides off-the-shelf camera modules and customized embedded vision solutions. At our technology campus strategically located in Europe, we combine R&D and manufacturing services under one roof and provide scalable manufacturing capacities up to millions of pieces.

Name: PAC
Description:
PAC, Precision Analyzer Company, is a leading global manufacturer of advanced analytical instruments for the aviation, renewable fuel, process, petrochemical, hydrocarbon, packaging, pharmaceutical, and medical device testing industries.
 
Our portfolio includes the world’s most respected brands of laboratory and process analyzers: AC Analytical Controls, Advanced Sensors, Alcor, Antek, Cambridge Viscosity, Herzog, Icon Scientific, ISL, PetroSpec, Phase Technology, and Uson.
 
With 15 sales and support offices and a network of over 140 distributors, PAC is proud to deliver global solutions with local support as we work to move the world forward, safely and sustainably.
 
PAC is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and 17025:2017 standards, reaffirming our commitment to quality and customer support.
 
Headquartered in Houston, Texas, PAC is a subsidiary of Indicor, LLC, a diversified technology company and a constituent of S&P 500, Fortune 1000, and Russel 1000 indices.

Name: Easy-Laser
Description:
Easy-Laser is one of the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of laser measurement systems for all types of industry. We provide extreme accuracy and precision. But that’s not what sets us apart. Today, when virtually anyone with a decent laser can do “straight”, to get ahead, you need to be a bit more forward-thinking.

Because, in the long run, what really counts is neither the absolute straightness of an individual component nor the precise alignment of shafts. It's what these measures add up to: Increased productivity and the saving of resources. Those are the things we ultimately deliver. And from that perspective our most important task is to help you make the road leading there as free from bumps and bends as possible.

That means developing user-friendly measurement and alignment systems that are as easy to get your head around, as they are versatile and scalable. It also means shortening delivery times, extending warranties and optimizing training and support.

Moreover, you can always expect us, or any of our partners, to give you an honest opinion on which of our products are crucial to your operations and which you can do without. What really needs to be aligned and what not. So that what we offer you is a solution perfectly aligned with your needs – and your budget.

Regardless of whether you're a service technician, a purchaser or the CFO of a multinational industrial group, you'll find Easy-Laser truly easy to deal with. Or as we like to put it – straightforward by all measures.

Name: Compleo
Description:
Compleo Charging Solutions GmbH & Co. KG is one of the leading full-service providers of charging technology in Europe. 
As part of the KOSTAL Group, the company supports its business customers with various charging stations and a backend for charging infrastructure. Compleo offers both AC and DC charging stations, including the first legally compliant DC charging stations on the market. The company is headquartered in Dortmund, Germany. Customers include Allego, Clever, EWE Go, Deutsche Telekom, Siemens, and more than 300 municipal utilities. The company is headquartered in Dortmund, Germany. Its customers include Allego, Clever, EWE Go, Deutsche Telekom, Siemens and more than 300 municipal utilities in Germany. 

https://www.compleo-charging.com/en/legal-notice

Name: LEMO GROUP
Description:
With a history of eight decades of excellence and innovation, the LEMO Group is a global leader in high-performance interconnection solutions.

From the depths of the oceans to space, from the freezing North Pole to the burning heart of jet engines, from operating theatres to car races, we connect everything that must not be accidentally disconnected.

Do you want to make a better future? With us, you will develop world-renowned solutions. With us, you will help technological leaders push back the limits of science, medicine, robotics, communication, transport, and energy.

Your diversity: the driving force of our excellence:

From raw material to components and finished products, the LEMO Group incorporates all the skills and expertise required for the development of complete interconnection solutions. The diversity of professions, cultures and individual pathways creates a stimulating environment.

1804 staff
42% women
51 nationalities
21 subsidiaries in the world

Name: Instagrid
Description:
Instagrid is redefining portable power, offering innovative, sustainable solutions that meet demanding energy needs – wherever you are. As a B Corp-certified company, we’re committed to not just reducing fuel emissions, but also enabling our customers to work cleaner, safer, and more efficiently. Our products, including Instagrid ONE, Instagrid GO, and Instagrid LINK, provide silent, fume-free, and grid-like power in any setting, eliminating the need for traditional generators. 

Designed with mobility in mind, our battery-based, portable power supplies are lightweight yet robust, allowing professionals in construction, film & media, emergency services, and events to power their work seamlessly. What sets us apart? 

- Single-handed portability: Our power units are lightweight, compact and designed for easy, one-person transport. 

- Unrivaled power: Our unique micro-inverter technology delivers high peak power for the most demanding tools.  

- Sustainable by design: Eliminate fuel costs and carbon emissions with our advanced battery technology, providing reliable, long-lasting power that keeps your operations running efficiently throughout the day. 

- Reliable in extreme conditions: Instagrid products perform in challenging environments, from remote construction sites to high-demand film sets. 

With a growing network of satisfied customers across industries and continents, we’re helping businesses achieve their sustainability goals while powering how work gets done. Join us on this journey to cleaner, smarter energy solutions that don’t compromise on performance or reliability.
⠀
#startups #electricity #power #pure #clean

Name: AP Sensing
Description:
AP Sensing offers distributed fiber optic sensing technology - DTS (Distributed Temperature Sensing), DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensing) and DTSS (Distributed Temperature and Strain Sensing) for a wide range of applications. Based on our HP heritage, with over 40 years of optical measurement expertise, we stand for top quality and well-designed solutions. 

Key applications include: Power Cable Monitoring, Fire/Heat Detection, Pipeline and LNG Monitoring, Well and Reservoir Monitoring, Rail Monitoring, Perimeter Monitoring, and Geo-and Hydrological applications.

Name: Selux Lighting
Description:
Selux is a leading supplier of sustainable lighting solutions for exterior applications. Every day light moves us to experience the new, time and time again. We at Selux are convinced that good light contributes to quality of life and for this reason we have made profound understanding of light and its effect the basis for our work.

Selux GmbH
Volkmarstr. 18
12099 Berlin
Germany
www.selux.com

Name: Fischer Connectors
Description:
Founded in 1954, Fischer Connectors designs, develops and deploys end-to-end interconnect solutions for ecosystems requiring local transfer and management of data, signals and power. Its tailored electronic solutions, connectors and cable assemblies are trusted globally for their reliability in demanding environments.

The company is part of the Swiss-headquartered technology group Conextivity. With 800+ employees worldwide, 1 R&D center located in Switzerland and supported by regional hubs, 3 main manufacturing sites and a network of partners, and 2 business activities (Fischer Connectors and Wearin'), Conextivity Group offers high-performance connectivity solutions that manage power and data flows seamlessly from sensors and devices to the cloud and AI, enabling the emergence of new transverse and scalable ecosystems.

Fischer Connectors’ products and solutions are tested to MIL-SPEC & IEC standards, and compliant with RoHS and REACH. They use the latest technologies in ruggedness, sealing, high-density miniaturization & data transmission for demanding, harsh-environment application fields such as defense & security, medical, robotics, automation, sensors and test & measurement. ISO 13485:2016 certified, Fischer Connectors manufactures quality products that are safe and reliable for integration into medical devices.

Fischer Connectors provides customers with:
- Standard or tailored solutions with dedicated technical support, consulting, system-level engineering, simulation and testing
- High responsiveness, fast prototyping and unrivalled lead times and customer service 
- IP68/IP69 sealing & hermeticity
- Weight optimization, high density, miniaturization
- Signal integrity, high-speed data transmission
- Cable assembly capabilities from design drawings, proofs of concept, prototypes to industrialized solutions
- Dedicated, pioneering electronic development from initial evaluation and proof of concept to design, industrial supply and life cycle management

Name: Delvitech SA
Description:
Delvitech designs, manufactures and supplies a sustainable AI based technological solution for the 3D automated optical inspection of assembled printed circuit boards.

In Delvitech R&D and Innovation are at the heart of every activity. Artificial intelligence is combined with an industry-leading engineering technology, resulting in a unique inspection machine for all SMT and THT production phases.

Characterized by self-programming features, Delvitech’s software, in conjunction with its proprietary patented multi-camera optical head, precision-engineered in Switzerland, delivers unparalleled inspection capabilities. The web-based software is unique, modern, singular and its ultimate goal is to automatically generate inspection programs, that can even be shared through the cloud.

The result is the continuous improvement of the entire manufacturing process, making it faster, steadier, more scalable.

Delvitech solution means less errors, less waste, less CO2, more future.

Name: LED Linear
Description:
LED Linear develops and manufactures high quality linear lighting systems based on LED for technically sophisticated interior and exterior lighting. Main products are linear and scalable lighting modules and systems based on LED, with an ingress protection from IP00 up to IP68. 

The product portfolio consists of various lighting systems, which have been nominated and granted prestigious international design awards. On the basis of the modular LED tool kit more than 20 million lighting fixtures can be built. Thus specific and individual custom solutions can be generated.  

LED Linear lighting systems are used in applications, varying from mood lighting to general lighting in office spaces, from under cabinet lighting, to façade lighting up to 300 meter heights. The use of high quality and long living components, provide energy saving and sustainable lighting solutions with an operating life of over 60.000 hrs. LED Linear products are lead free soldered and RoHS compliant. LED Linear trade marks are LED Linear GmbH are: LED LinearTM, LEDsClickTM, TjAwayTM, VarioLEDTM, HYDRALUXTM, XOOLIGHTTM, XOOLINETM, XOOLUMTM, XOOLUXTM, XOOMINAIRETM, XOOMINARISTM, XOOMINESCENTTM, XOOTUBETM. 

LED Linear products are sold at many locations worldwide through a network of partners and distributors. Our branches are located in the USA, Canada, Singapore, India, Australia, France, Spain, UK and in the Middle East. Worldwide, the company has about 155 employees. 

The company also has a good network in the lighting design community and works together on a friendly basis with many design offices. One example is Mrs. Gabriela Vidal, Lighting Designer formed in Wismar as an Architectural LD, Master, now based in Palma de Mallorca, Spain. She is specialized with all LED Linear products through her work for the company.

Name: Pepperl+Fuchs - Enterprise Mobility
Description: Enterprise Mobility Solutions from Pepperl+Fuchs are following customer ́s requests and needs paving the way for future-oriented digitalization. Offering a one-stop competitive solution concept and portfolio to enable the next level of enterprise centric digitalization (starting from hardware to experienced system and application engineers, google certified and Silver partner, MDM portfolio to 5G and infrastructure partnerships). This opens up completely new possibilities and increases the safety, efficiency, and transparency of operations in both conventional and IIOT applications. Driving value through connected mobile worker solutions and digital transformation is resulting into Pepperl+Fuchs Enterprise Mobility.

Name: FILIX by luminii
Description:
FILIX Lighting was founded in 1990 with the main idea of developing illumination solutions. Today our focus is production of high end professional luminaries.

With implementation of modern technology and trough research and development we are able to create LED products that minimize and optimize energy consumption, while delivering maximum light output and desired effects.

By using your experience in lighting and illumination, together with our products you can bring your designs to life, enhance architecture and landscapes and change the perception of space. 

Who we are ?

Today Filix represents an evolving and production oriented company whose major focus is development and production of LED Lighting Fixtures. Products come into being from the very basic idea where our team together with our clients develop solutions that will suit their needs, create required effects and ensure durability. Products are developed from scratch; separate segments are designed and researched on order to provide the required outcome. 

The product range is currently based on high quality outdoor lighting fixtures whose main purpose is to decorate and illuminate outdoor spaces and areas.Our luminaries bring  dark spaces into being by making them pleasant and safe living environments accessible to all.

Name: Siglent Technologies CO., Ltd
Description:
SIGLENT TECHNOLOGIES began in 2002 with the development of its first digital oscilloscopes. Since then, the company has rapidly expanded its portfolio to cover a broad range of general-purpose electronic test and measurement instruments, including oscilloscopes, signal and function/arbitrary waveform generators, digital multimeters, laboratory power supplies, electronic DC loads, spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers (VNAs), and RF signal generators.

With the introduction of the Performance Line Series in 2021, SIGLENT further advanced its technical capabilities to address demanding applications in high-performance measurement environments, including solutions reaching into the microwave frequency range up to 40 GHz.

Today, SIGLENT TECHNOLOGIES is a globally recognized provider of electronic test and measurement equipment, combining innovative features, strong engineering expertise, and reliable performance. Headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with international subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Japan, and Malaysia, SIGLENT supports customers in more than 80 countries worldwide.

SIGLENT is certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 standards, reflecting its commitment to consistent product quality and responsible environmental management.

Name: EIZO
Description: EIZO, which means image in Japanese, is a visual technology company that develops and manufactures high-end visual solutions to enrich people in their professional and personal lives. EIZO offers total imaging solutions with a range of monitors, software, video capture, processing, and distribution solutions, cameras, and advanced integrated technologies, to meet the specialized needs of customers in business, creative fields, healthcare, air traffic control, maritime, security & surveillance, and more. Headquartered in Hakusan, Japan, EIZO has R&D and manufacturing facilities in Japan, China, Germany, and the United States, and representation in more than 90 countries.

Name: AED Vantage
Description:
To prepare for the mobility of tomorrow, we concept, develop and test customer specific electronic solutions. 
With our know-how in the areas of software, electronics design, optimization of the system architecture as well as validation, we support you as a holistic partner - from the first idea to series production, or only for one or more sub-areas depending on your needs.

In this new era of mobility, we aim to offer you unique and sustainable solutions. This will enable us to accelerate the new development of innovative vehicle technology and ensure its reliability.

Name: ITT Cannon
Description: Cannon is a flagship brand of ITT Inc. and a global leader in highly engineered, harsh environment electrical connectors for the aerospace and defense, oil and gas, medical, transportation and industrial markets.

Name: DEHN SE
Description:
DEHN, headquartered in Neumarkt i.d.OPf., Germany, develops and manufactures devices for the reliable protection of persons, buildings, electrical and electronic systems against the effects of lightning and surges.

Thanks to our pioneering spirit we have been pushing developments in the fields of surge protection, lightning protection and safety equipment for more than 100 years, making us a trusted expert in these fields. At the same time, we are continuously expanding our international activities. With 20 subsidiaries and sales offices throughout the world, our sales activities are adapted to suit country-specific conditions and include active pre-marketing, short delivery times as well as product availability thanks to modern logistics.

DEHN protects. The slogan of our company has been both an obligation and an incentive for the past four generations of our family-owned company. A promise we keep with expertise and dedication – for the benefit of our customers, partners and employees.

Legal Notice: http://de.hn/imprint
Location: Neumarkt in der Oberpfalz, Bavaria, Germany

Name: Optoma
Description:
Experience more.

With customer needs and the user experience at the centre of everything we do, Optoma’s projection, LED and interactive flat panel display products combine superior image processing technologies with exceptional engineering and innovation to deliver stunning crystal clear images with ultimate reliability. 

Designed for professional AV and home entertainment, our award-winning projectors use DLP technology, pioneered by Texas Instruments.

The Optoma Group has continental headquarters in Europe, the USA and Asia Pacific. Optoma Europe, based in London, covers Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). Local services are delivered from multiple offices across this region.

Name: Elcometer Inspection Equipment
Description:
For more than seventy years Elcometer has been a world leader in the design, manufacture and supply of Coating Inspection and Physical Test Equipment, Ultrasonic NDT equipment and Abrasive Blast Equipment.

Ever Since the first Elcometer gauge was manufactured in 1947, our philosophy has been to provide "best in class" design, quality and service at a competitive price. 
 
Elcometer has over 150 Distributors across more than 70 countries around the world, all trained to give you a comprehensive sales and after sales service and support whenever and wherever you may be.

Name: SCHURTER Group
Description:
The SCHURTER Group is a globally successful Swiss technology company. With our components ensuring the clean and safe supply of power, input systems for easeof use and sophisticated overall solutions, we impress our customers with agility and excellent product and service quality. 

As a leading innovator, SCHURTER manufactures and distributes components for circuit protection, as well as connectors, switches and EMC products. In close cooperation with the customers, input systems are developed and manufactured. SCHURTER also offers services for the electronics industry in the field of printed circuit board assembly. The business unit Solutions coordinates complete solutions from project planning to the manufacture of end products.

22 companies in 17 countries belong to the SCHURTER Group, 11 companies of which have their own production sites. This ensures that all major markets can be served by their own companies. They are coordinated from three hubs: SCHURTER AG in Lucerne for Europe, SCHURTER Inc. in Santa Rosa for America as well as SCHURTER (S) Pte. Ltd. in Singapore for Asia. In addition, SCHURTER has representatives in about 60 countries and works together with over 200 distributors. This close-knit network guarantees that SCHURTER products are securely and quickly available internationally.

Name: Isola Group
Description: Isola Group, headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, is a global material sciences company focused on designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing copper-clad laminates and dielectric prepregs used to fabricate advanced multilayer printed circuit boards. The company’s high-performance materials are used in sophisticated electronic applications in the communications infrastructure, computing/networking, military, medical, aerospace and automotive industries.

Name: Einhell Germany AG
Description:
Every company has a mission. What's ours?  
As a leading manufacturer of cutting-edge tools, our mission at Einhell is to bring a sense of freedom to every home and garden.
With our innovative battery platform Power X-Change, which already includes over 300 battery-powered tools and gardening equipment, we as battery specialists have been inspiring the Do-It-Yourself sector for many years and scripting an unparalleled success story along the way. Based in Landau an der Isar, Lower Bavaria, we have expanded our presence to over 90 countries, with our growth trajectory showing no signs of slowing down.

With our team spirit, determination and passion, we are ready to take on any challenge the future holds for us. Together, we are working towards this great vision, shaping the DIY market of tomorrow, setting the tone and inspiring people worldwide to turn their creative ideas into reality.

We are dynamic, successful, international. 
We are #TeamEinhell.

Name: HELU Group
Description:
Who is behind HELU?

Behind HELU are around 2,500 employees working at 76 locations across 43 countries. Highly motivated and dedicated, we work every day with precision and focus to develop innovative solutions.

From individual cables to complete system solutions, we deliver products that do more than simply work—they inspire. Whether in mechanical engineering, industrial automation, or renewable energy applications, our solutions make a difference.

And the best part? Our products, made in Germany, are recognized worldwide for their quality and reliability.

Name: Georg Neumann GmbH
Description: Georg Neumann GmbH, with its headquarters in Berlin, Germany, is well-known as one of the world's leading manufacturers of microphones. The company, which was established in 1928, has a long track record of world-leading product designs and has been recognized with a string of international awards for its technology innovations.   From 2010, Neumann offers this expertise in electro-acoustic transducer technologies to the studio monitoring market, and will provide optimum solutions to its customers in the areas of TV and radio broadcasting, recording, and audio productions. Neumann is now the perfect partner for both the input and the output of the audio signal path. Neumann has manufacturing facilities in Germany (microphones) and Ireland (loudspeakers), and is represented in over 50 countries worldwide by Sennheiser subsidiaries, as well as by long-term trading partners. Georg Neumann GmbH is a Sennheiser Group company.

Name: imc Test & Measurement
Description:
Since 1988, imc Test & Measurement has been committed to support industrial innovations with optimal measurement solutions. Our integrated and flexible data acquisition platform supports test engineers across industries including automotive, mechanical engineering, railway, aerospace, and energy. Every day, imc DAQ systems, software, and test stands are used worldwide to validate prototypes, optimize products, monitor processes, and transform measurement data into actionable insights. From road load data acquisition and durability testing to EV and battery testing, NVH analysis, torsional vibration, and sound power measurement, imc delivers solutions precisely tailored to your application.
As a comprehensive solution provider, imc also offers a broad portfolio of services. These ranges from consulting and training to contract measurements, data analysis, and customized turnkey test benches. Backed by a global team of experienced engineers, we combine deep technical expertise with extensive project experience to help customers achieve their testing goals faster and more efficiently.

Name: Gantner
Description:
Gantner is one of the main three core brands that constitute a unique brand platform: SALTO WECOSYSTEM.

Gantner develops reliable and smart identification in the fields of electronic access control, smart locker systems, and cashless payment that automate and digitize business processes, optimizing organizational efficiency and security.

Established in 1982, Gantner has been at the forefront of contactless Near Field Communication (NFC) electronic technology, setting industry standards with innovative solutions. ISO certified for quality, environmental, and information security management, Gantner is acclaimed for innovation and employee-friendly practices. With a flat hierarchy and emphasis on initiative, we foster a creative and learning-driven work environment.

Make sure to also follow our other two main core brands:

Salto — continues to lead the way in pioneering building access, identity management, and electronic locking technology that ensures a secure, smart, and seamless user experience.

Vintia — specializes in ticketing and booking systems that revolutionize the customer experience in the leisure and attractions sector.
 
For further information, please check out our website at www.gantner.com and our official brand platform at www.saltowecosystem.com.

Name: Inxpect
Description:
Inxpect imagines, designs, manufactures and distributes intelligent sensors based on 3D radar technology. These sensors can combine safety in the working environment with continuity of production, all in full compliance with the most up-to-date international safety standards.

Developed to function flawlessly even in the harshest environments, our solutions are already used in many industries, from industrial automation to robotics.
We license our technology for other markets as well, including security and building automation.

Inxpect's S101A was the first and is still the only safety radar sensor for industrial use in the world.

///

Inxpect pensa, progetta, produce e distribuisce sensori intelligenti basati su tecnologia radar 3D, capaci di coniugare sicurezza nell'ambiente di lavoro e continuità produttiva, il tutto in perfetta conformità agli standard internazionali di sicurezza più aggiornati.

Sviluppate per funzionare perfettamente anche negli ambienti più difficili, le nostre soluzioni sono già utilizzate in molti settori, dall'automazione industriale alla robotica.
Abbiamo concesso in licenza la nostra tecnologia anche per altri mercati, tra cui quello della sicurezza e dell'automazione degli edifici.

L'S101A di Inxpect è stato il primo ed è tuttora l'unico sensore radar di sicurezza per uso industriale al mondo.

Name: SITECO
Description:
SITECO represents the future of light and has done so for over 160 years. Today, we are the market leader in holistic lighting solutions: product, control, installation and operation – all from a single source.
Our approximately 1,000 employees worldwide work daily on customised lighting solutions for cities, industry, offices, sports, tunnels and retail. We live Made in Traunreut, Germany, because our aim is nothing less than to create the most efficient and sustainable lighting solutions in the world.

Name: Ocean Optics
Description:
Ocean Optics pioneered miniature spectrometers and delivers spectral solutions to researchers, OEMs and industrial customers, also designs and builds industrial-grade photonics systems for material inspection, chemical identification and quality assurance.

Our mission is to lead in creating precise yet practical optical solutions that enable researchers and industry to solve meaningful problems in health, safety and the environment. OUR HISTORY
Ocean Optics started in the late ‘80s, seeded by a federal grant for a marine pH sensor. As part of their work, the Ocean team needed a compact spectrometer to fit into a small, underwater housing, and were surprised to discover none existed. So, they made their own. Founder Mike Morris started the evolution of spectrometers from floor unit-sized to handheld.

By 1992, the “world’s first miniature spectrometer” ushered in a new way of utilizing spectroscopy.

Description:

Our passion for sustainability drives us to continually advance our technology, helping our partners achieve accurate, reliable results while minimizing their environmental impact. 

Whether it’s monitoring emissions for compliance, analyzing complex gas mixtures, or conducting cutting-edge research, Gasmet is your trusted partner for reliable gas analysis.

Description: TRACO Electronic AG is a Swiss company with headquarters based in Baar, Switzerland. Name: go-e
Description:
The Austrian company go-e GmbH is an internationally operating manufacturer of AC charging stations for electric vehicles with a charging capacity of up to 22 kW. The roots of go-e lie in the search for innovative solutions for e-mobility and the sustainable thinking and actions of the two company founders. They founded the company in 2015 as part of a Kickstarter project for their ONwheel bicycle motor in Feldkirchen, Carinthia, Austria. With this, an electrically powered bicycle could be built from a normal bicycle in the simplest way. Two years later, the start-up presented its first smart charging station for electric cars. With the presentation of the first go-eCharger including high-end equipment at an excellent price-performance ratio, go-e set new standards for charging solutions.

The company, which currently has around 80 employees, has since developed into an internationally established supplier for the production and sale of accessories for e-mobility, especially intelligent AC charging stations. In addition, go-e is active as an OEM development partner as well as an OEM producer and offers its own products as white label. Customers currently receive charging technology from go-e in 20 European countries via a constantly growing network of around 1,000 partners, dealers and specialist companies. go-e is committed to the values of innovative development, a sustainable approach to the environment and social competence in dealing with employees, partners and customers. Production takes place as sustainably as possible at the Austrian company site in Feldkirchen. In addition to the hardware, go-e also develops the software that brings the smart functions of all go-e charging stations to life.

Name: BAUR GmbH
Description:

High grade products, onsite consultation and intensive training programs and comprehensive service from BAUR guarantee optimum status monitoring of electrical insulation materials and power supply systems. With this, the company makes significant contribution towards efficient and problem-free power supply around the globe.

BAUR is always one step ahead. Constant innovations in power generation and distribution demand quick adaptation of the measurement and testing technology. To meet these requirements, BAUR bets on maximum flexibility and continuous consolidation of its core competencies: Cable testing and fault location, diagnosis and evaluation of reliability of cable systems and dielectric insulation material tests. At BAUR, we have merged long years of experience and passion for technology with the ambition for continuous advanced technological development.

BAUR customers include power station companies, network operators, public utility companies as well as industrial and service companies around the world. Intensive contact with customers and consistent implementation of their expectations for technical solutions are given the highest priority at BAUR.

Name: Lightnet GmbH
Description:

With lighting solutions that convince aesthetically and technologically. We have a global presence, thanks to over 40 of our own sales organisations. Our customer base spans the complete spectrum of end users of analytical instrumentation typically found in industrial, governmental and academic laboratories. Name: AQUALAB (by Addium)

Description:
System solutions for the KNX standard

One stop Development

The basis for your development
The core of our services are solutions for the integration of KNX devices. A wide range of KNX modules and KNX stacks also offers a cost-effective connection for your devices on KNX.

System devices for KNX

Help to shape the future

Description:
DataPhysics Instruments GmbH is a German company from the Stuttgart region. It has been developing, manufacturing, and distributing laboratory measuring devices for the characterisation of interfaces and surfaces for over 25 years. With 45 employees, and a worldwide distribution network, the company is one of the leading manufacturers of analytical, high-precision systems in this field.

In short, the laboratory measuring devices from DataPhysics Instruments are used whenever a liquid meets another liquid or a solid. More precisely, the devices can be used to determine important physical and chemical parameters such as surface tension and surface energy, force of adhesion, static and dynamic contact angles, roughness, zeta potential, and destabilisation mechanisms.

The product portfolio includes:
- contact angle meters of the OCA series - optical measuring systems for determining many parameters of interfaces and surfaces, such as surface tension and energy, interfacial tension, as well as static and dynamic contact angles.
- tensiometers of the DCAT series - force-based instruments for investigating a number of interface and surface parameters, such as surface tension and energy, interfacial tension, dynamic contact angle, as well as critical micelle formation concentration and force of adhesion.
- SVT 25 spinning drop tensiometer - for characterising extremely low interfacial tensions between two liquids and interfacial rheology.
- MultiScan MS 20 dispersion stability analysis system - for investigating the stability of multiphase mixtures such as emulsions and suspensions, regarding their long-term storage stability and their destabilisation mechanisms.
- ZPA 20 zeta potential analyzer - with patented measuring method for the precise determination of the zeta potential, of plate-shaped solids, membranes, fibre bundles, and powders.
- humidity generators of the HGC series - for the control and adjustment of relative humidity in small measuring chambers

Rohrer Mess- & Systemtechnik stellt in München ein anspruchsvolles Programm messtechnischer Geräte und Systeme her. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden entwickeln und lösen wir hochkomplexe Aufgaben.
Als Partner der Forschungseinrichtungen von Industrie u. Universitäten werden wir den hohen Ansprüchen seit über 30 Jahren erfolgreich gerecht. Die vielfältigen Einsatzgebiete reichen von der Automobilindustrie, Energietechnik, Metrologie, Luft- & Raumfahrt, Bahn, Magnettechnik, Strahlablenkung, um nur einige zu nennen.
Gegründet 1975 begannen wir mit kundenspezifischen Stromversorgungen. Drei Jahre später haben wir den ersten Mess-Trennverstärker (Vorgänger des legendären T303) mit 10 kV/300 kHz, vorgestellt. 1989 und 1992 wurden wir als Systemlieferant gegen intern. Wettbewerb für die Lieferung der Quadrupol Magnete ausgewählt.
Unsere neue Modellserie PA-LV124/148 wird die Versorgungsspannung am DUT (Device Under Test) sogar dann geregelt, wenn die Last sich ändert. Damit lassen sich Testabläufe reproduzierbar automatisieren und dokumentieren.

Rohrer Mess- & Systemtechnik produces a sophisticated range of measurement devices and systems in Munich. Together with our customers we develop and solve highly complex tasks.
As a partner of the research institutions of industry / universities, we have successfully met the high demands for over 30 years. The diverse areas of application range from the automotive industry, energy technology, metrology, aerospace, rail, magnetic technology, beam deflection, to name just a few.
Founded in 1975, we started with customized power supplies. Three years later we introduced the first measuring isolating amplifier (predecessor of the legendary T303) with 10 kV / 300 kHz. In 1989 and 1992 we were selected as a system supplier against intern. competition for the delivery of quadrupole magnets.
Our new model series PA-LV124/148 regulates the supply voltage at the DUT even when the load changes. Test processes can thus be reproducibly automated.

Bereits nach wenigen Monaten konnte die Anzahl der täglichen Neuaufträge derart gesteigert werden, dass ein Eildienst, inzwischen bereits ab 3 AT Lieferzeit, eingerichtet werden konnte. Mit diesen Möglichkeiten ließ auch die Einführung des Poolservice für 4-Lagen Multilayer nicht lange auf sich warten.

Seit Januar 2018 gehört die Q-print electronic GmbH zur ALBA PCB Group. Starkes Auftreten mit eigenen Produktionsstätten in Europa und Asien bedeuten für uns und unsere Kunden eine stabile Basis für die Zukunft. Der Fokus der Q-print electronic GmbH verbleibt weiterhin bei der Lieferung von Prototypen, Mustermengen und Eildiensten, wird nun aber optimal ergänzt über die gruppeninternen Fertigungen für Serien aus Asien und Sondertechnologien.

Description:
Anyone who monitors vibrations needs data they can trust. Our measurement systems provide the foundation for reliable decisions – precise, standard-compliant, and always verifiable.

Certified according to DIN EN ISO 9001 and backed by more than a decade of experience, we are a trusted partner for construction companies, engineering firms, expert surveyors, and infrastructure operators.
 
At the heart of our portfolio is the MENHIR measurement system, which captures vibrations with precision – whether in construction projects, road and rail traffic, or geothermal applications. It is complemented by the METRIS analysis software, enabling detailed evaluation of complex measurement data, and the SEDRIX cloud platform, which offers web-based remote access, data visualization, and automated reporting – without the need for local installation.
 
By combining hardware, software, and services, SEMEX-EngCon covers the entire measurement chain from a single source. All systems comply with DIN 45669 as well as other national and international application standards. The flexible intercommunication between multiple devices is unique in the market.
 
Our services include fast delivery of measurement systems, technical support, and project-accompanying assistance – for both short-term campaigns and long-term monitoring.
 
Our mission is clear: to minimize risks, create predictability, and enable reliable decisions. Because safety begins with knowledge – and with data you can trust.

Name: COGD (Component Obsolescence Group Deutschland) e.V.

Im Industrie-Interessenverband COGD (Component Obsolescence Group Deutschland) e.V. beschäftigen sich Gleichgesinnte mit dem Thema Obsolescence Management. Ziel ist es, die Folgen der Nichtverfügbarkeit von Komponenten in Produkten zu minimieren oder diesen Fall zu verhindern.
Die Produktlebenszyklen von High-Tech-Komponenten und Komplettprodukten laufen in den letzten Jahrzehnten immer weiter auseinander. Moderne Komponenten werden teilweise schon nach 6 Monaten von ihren nicht immer kompatiblen Nachfolgern abgelöst. In Raumfahrt, Militärtechnik, Bahntechnik, Kraftwerkstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik und in anderen Branchen sollen Produkte aber viele Jahre möglichst unverändert geliefert werden. Sind Komponenten eines Produktes oder Systems nicht mehr verfügbar, spricht man von Obsolescence.
Obsolescence Management kann man als Teilaspekt des Life Cycle Managements interpretieren.
Mitglieder in unserem Verein haben die folgenden Vorteile:
•	Zugriff auf sämtliche Präsentationen und gemeinsam erarbeitete Empfehlungen zum Obsolescence-Management, sowohl der COGD als auch der COG UK, die sich 2015 in IIOM (International Institute of Obsolescence Management) umbenannt hat
•	Vierteljährliche Zusammenkünfte mit Fachvorträgen, Berichten über Initiativen von Arbeitsgruppen und Diskussionsgruppen
•	Einsteuern von Aufgabenstellungen, die durch gemeinsam ausgewählte Institute bearbeitet werden sollen

Name: Beck GmbH Druckkontrolltechnik
Description: Whether in Europe, Asia, the Middle East or the Americas: When things get critical, Beck's innovative technology is used almost everywhere in the world. The tailor-made pressure monitors and pressure sensors monitor limit values of positive and negative pressures as well as differential pressures with high intrinsic safety. Certified quality products, which are manufactured by our specialists exclusively at the company headquarters in Germany - and which have been securing Beck's leading position on the international industrial market for more than five decades. With a water level indicator for household washing machines, Walter Beck laid the foundation for today's company. Shortly thereafter, he developed a membrane pressure switch for monitoring the water level for the first washing machine. After a stormy period of growth, Beck developed into one of the world's leading manufacturers of pressure switches for household appliances in the 1960s. In the mid-seventies, Beck opened up new sales markets and expanded his customer base with a variety of industrial applications. In 1985 Beck introduced a differential pressure switch for fan monitoring in gas heaters. At the end of the eighties, Beck established itself with an adjustable differential pressure monitor for the monitoring of air filters and blowers in ventilation and air conditioning. In 2000, Beck added to its product range for this now-significant sales market with a differential pressure transducer, further expanding its global market position. In addition, Beck continues to see itself as a flexible niche provider of customer-specific pressure monitors and pressure transducers for original equipment manufacturers in a wide range of industries. This pronounced diversification of sales markets should be regarded as a key factor for the international market success achieved.

•	navigation test environments
•	and many more.

IFEN, founded in 1998, was starting up with service contracts on EGNOS development, later also on Galileo. The scope of activities for service contracts covers GNSS system studies and analysis, development of algorithms, software and facilities, even up to turnkey systems like the Galileo test range GATE. Service contracts in all fields of GNSS remain an important source of work, turnover and know-how for us until today.

As a result of our entrance to the commercial market, our growth in staff and experience was boosted tremendously. The system can be easily connected to building automation or other systems for data analysis. 

Healthcare and Hospitals:
SensFloor helps care organizations to optimize their workflows and provide more security to their patients or residents. Operators of care homes especially appreciate functionalities like fall-detection, automatic light control and long-term activity monitoring.

Neurology, Geriatrics and Rehab:
Objective gait recording and comparing. Based on the gait pattern, an expert can identify a possible risk of falling and determine the evidence of treatment progress. 

Retail, Trade Fairs and Exhibitions:
SensFloor is ideal for visualizing visitor flows. Customers are counted, their routes tracked and time patterns identified. Based on this data, the room design can be optimized. 

Multimedia:
Presence-triggered and accurate localization for controlling multimedia displays or interaction in art and games.

SINOWELL is an innovation-driven company specializing in intelligent growing technologies. We believe technology should do more than create products—it should create environments where life can grow. Because when life grows, people, businesses, and the future grow with it.
