Since inventing the first cyclonic bagless vacuum cleaner, the DC01, Dyson has consistently invested in research and development to improve its products and technologies radically. Dyson offers products across a growing range of areas: floorcare, air purification, robotics, haircare including formulations, lighting, hand drying, and most recently audio. Dyson continues to expand into new areas.

Today, Dyson sells products in more than 80 markets, has 450 Dyson stores worldwide and is available in all major technology and beauty retailers. Dyson has global headquarters in Singapore and major technology campuses in Singapore, the UK, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global team of engineers, scientists and software developers are focused on developing technology-enabled products which work better and which people love to use. Key areas of focus have included high-speed electric digital motors, sensing and vision systems, robotics, machine learning and aerodynamics. 

Beyond products, to encourage an inventive future, Dyson is also inspiring the next generation of engineers and inventors through the Dyson Institute of Engineering and Technology, the James Dyson Foundation and the James Dyson Award.  

The Dyson family applies its problem-solving approach in other fields, and established Dyson Farming in 2012. It is one of the largest farming businesses in the UK, extending to 36,000 acres across Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire and Somerset. It is a family-owned enterprise unlike any other, focussed on long-term investment in British farming and the countryside to grow tasty and nutritious food.

They necessitate iterative development, IP safety, fast time-to-market and device performance gains, thereby mandating AME for in-house, rapid prototyping and production. That is where we believe we can make a contribution: with the development of marketable, future-oriented energy storage solutions for numerous areas of application, we help to develop, among other things, the expansion of electrical energy supply from regenerative energy sources, enable stable grids and promote digitalization and automation.

Name: VERMES Microdispensing GmbH
Description:
Headquartered in the metropolitan region of Munich (Germany), VERMES Microdispensing revolutionized microdispensing technology with the introduction of its contact free piezo based MDS 3000 series in 2001. Today, the company is a world leader in the design and manufacture of innovative microdispensing concepts and systems for adhesives, silicones, greases, solvents and other fluids.

VERMES Microdispensing high precision valves support modern manufacturing processes across the globe, e.g. for automotive, medicine, pharmacology, smart phones, gadgets, automated manufacture of LEDs, RFID tags and many other electronic devices.

Our systems enable our customers to achieve contact-free dispensing of highly viscous media droplets with precision in the micro, nano and sub-nano liter range and highest frequencies; a performance that is unique in our industry.

VERMES Microdispensing employees are dedicated to providing the best technologies and services to its customers around the world with the ultimate aim of contributing to increased throughput, improved quality and lower production costs.

Name: SCHMIDT + HAENSCH
Description:

Name: Metglas, Inc.
Description:
METGLAS Inc., located in Conway, SC, is a world's leading producer of Amorphous Metal Ribbon. In 1970’s, Metglas, Inc. (then Allied Signal located in Morristown, NJ) pioneered the development and production of amorphous metal, a unique alloy that exhibits a structure in which the metal atoms occur in a random pattern. The key to Metglas Inc.’s proprietary manufacturing process is the rapid-solidification of molten alloy at a rate of approximately one million degrees Celsius per second. 


Metglas Amorphous Metals have a unique non-crystalline structure and possess excellent physical and magnetic properties that combine strength and hardness with flexibility and toughness. Metglas and Metglas products help companies around the globe reduce operating costs, strengthen energy conservation efforts and increase application efficiency.

Name: Narda Safety Test Solutions GmbH
Description:
Narda Safety Test Solutions is synonymous with precision measurement technology wherever electromagnetic fields need to be understood, evaluated, and controlled. Whether protecting people from electromagnetic radiation, monitoring complex radio environments, or pinpointing sources of interference - our solutions deliver reliable results, even under the most demanding conditions. Our systems are used worldwide:

• to ensure compliance with legal limits in occupational safety and environmental protection
• to analyze and evaluate modern wireless technologies such as 5G
• to detect and locate signals in safety-critical applications
• to ensure the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of devices

From broadband field strength meters and frequency-selective analyzers to real-time receivers and automatic direction-finding systems, Narda offers a comprehensive portfolio for measurement tasks in the field, in the laboratory, and in continuous operation. What sets us apart: Measurement accuracy you can rely on - worldwide.
Supported by accredited calibration laboratories, practical software solutions, and comprehensive service, we guide our customers from measurement through to robust evaluation.

Name: Citel USA
Description:

CITEL's thorough understanding of local standards and regulations, along with a continuous investment in R&D, inspire us to design, manufacture and supply millions of SPDs each year to our clients who are conscious of the danger transients pose and actively take steps to eliminate the threat.

CITEL develops many of our critical surge protection components internally including gas discharge tubes, thermally protected varistors and high-energy varistor assemblies. This means that CITEL has expertise into every minute detail of the parts that make up an SPD.

Our teams all over the globe are proud to bring our clients a comprehensive product range of surge protectors that is unmatched in customer service and product quality.

CITEL is unique, like each of our clients. Unique, as our strategic vision places financial independence, international technical collaboration and strong individual commitment at the forefront of who we are.

Name: Newson Gale
Description:
For over 40 years, Newson Gale has been in the business of protecting people and assets from static hazards serving industries where processes that generate significant amounts of static electricity have the potential to ignite flammable or explosive atmospheres.

Static electricity continues to be one of the industry’s most significant sources of igniting flammable and explosive gas and dust atmospheres. Statistics from leading organisations such as The Institute of Chemical Engineers and NFPA indicate that at least two serious fires or explosions are caused every day by uncontrolled static electrical discharges in industrial operations worldwide. 

The Newson Gale globally certified product range mitigates static charge accumulation by using practical and innovative design and ensures effective static control on three levels – grounding and bonding clamps, visual verification and interlockable control systems:
•	Static ground indicators and interlock systems via our Earth-Rite range.
•	Self-testing static electricity grounding clamp units via our Bond-Rite series.
•	Static grounding and bonding clamps, cables, and reels via our Cen-StatTM range.

Published data shows that ignitions from static discharges rank as highly as over-pressure faults in petrochemical handling and are second only to mechanical sparks for dust explosions.

Effective January 4, 2016, Newson Gale has become a member of the HOERBIGER Group.

This makes it possible to suppress interfering noise such as street noise, crowd noise or room reverberation, and to create a higher order of directivity without a change in sound colour.

We are looking forward to an exciting successful future in the USI family.

Name: HT Global Circuits
Description:
HT Global Circuits: Making the impossible look easy.

H&T Global Circuits is a worldwide leader in Printed Circuit Boards. We are privately owned and can provide corporations (small and large) worldwide manufacturing solutions to meet the ever changing global market.

H&T Global Circuits is comprised of diverse and dedicated professionals who are ready and willing to go an extra mile to assist their customers. Teams are located throughout Asia, Europe and the United States; sales and engineering professionals will be there every step of the way providing excellent customer service and technical support. 

“It is a pleasure dealing with [our H&T customer service representative], her positive, can-do-attitude makes dealing with her a great experience.”

We are uniquely suited to support any requirement, in any time zone, in almost any language. 

“Your unrequested updates are one of the highly remembered acts of customer service that makes the biggest difference between competitive sources ... Thanks.”

We produce single-sided, double-sided and multilayer boards – Rigid, Rigid-Flexible and Flexible PCBs; flex and rigid-flex circuits, RoHs Compliant Boards, Hybrids, Heat-sink Applications, Carbon Ink, Peelable Mask, Jump Score, Blind and Buried Vias, 3/3 Mil Minimum Line Width/Space, Controlled Impedance, Die Punch (Hard Tool) and Exotic materials. 

H&T Global Circuits offers a variety of surface finishes including: Electroless Nickel, Immersion Gold (ENIG), Hard Gold, Bondable Gold, Nickel, Immersion Tin, Immersion Silver, Organic Solderability Preservative (OSP) and Lead Free (HASL).

Worldwide production leads to an accurate and timely supply of printed circuit boards – every time.

Name: Micro Systems Technologies
Description:
The Micro Systems Technologies (MST) group provides innovative components and services for technologically advanced industries that demand miniaturisation, exceptional performance and the highest level of reliability. Examples therefor are medical technology, aerospace & aviation, and challenging applications in telecommunication, industrial electronics and sensor technology.

Active around the globe, the MST group consists of three technology companies with more than 900 employees in two countries, all of whom offer their customers integrated solutions from conceptual design through series production.

Name: steute Technologies
Description:
For more than 50 years, steute Schaltgeräte has been developing and manufacturing sensors and control units which meet the highest standards of quality and reliability. The steute portfolio encompasses a wide range of standard products, as well as numerous customised devices, and is divided into four business areas: Wireless, Automation, Extreme and Meditec.

All four steute business fields are geared to collaborate closely with end users and to take customer requirements into account from the development stage onwards. To this end, improved premises were built in late 2012. The new Development Centre on site in Löhne provides ample space for around 50 hard and software developers, as well as for state-of-the-art test equipment. 

As a medium-sized company, steute is able to react quickly and flexibly to market trends and customer requirements. This is one of the reasons why the company continues to grow, together with a specialisation in well-defined, particularly complex tasks related to automation technology and man-machine interfaces.
Much of the growth is due to an increased presence in new, international markets. steute has subsidiaries in 11 countries around the world, and sales and service partners in a further 30. 

At the end of 2012, not only the new Development Centre, but also a production plant in Shanghai/China was opened. All this expansion has created a need for new staff. steute currently employs approx. 300 people worldwide.

Imprint: https://www.steute.com/en/imprint

Name: Shure DACH
Description:
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahre 2002 setzen wir, das Team von Shure, uns täglich das Ziel, für unsere Kunden die “Enabler” zu sein: wir sind Ihre “Möglichmacher”.
Kompetente Beratung, schnelle Lieferung, freundlicher Rundum-Service sowie die tatkräftige Unterstützung Ihrer Projekte stehen bei uns im Mittelpunkt.

Name: DESKO GmbH
Description:
For more than 30 years, we have been developing solutions for data capture from documents such as ID cards, barcode tickets, magnetic stripe and chip cards. From pure data and image capture to a full document authentication - there are numerous fields of applications for DESKO hardware and software. The wide product portfolio ranges from simple document readers to complete standalone self-service solutions, tailored to the varying needs of the customers.
DESKO solutions involve the knowledge of 30 years of experience and usage in the field. The hardware and software products are internal developments manufactured in cooperation with regional partners. “Made in Germany” is a seal of approval standing for quality and reliability. DESKO sticks to this standard and focuses on the locational advantage of Germany.

Name: depsys
Description:
depsys is a Swiss technology company empowering grid managers to evolve their operations through digital technology. 

By providing unparalleled intelligence, insight, and control, depsys enables grid managers to simply and successfully manage their operational transition and to guarantee sustainable electricity for future generations.

ARE YOU A DSO WHO WANTS TO:

* Gain visibility on your grid estate?
* Know the impact of a PV installation or heat pumps on your grid?
* Evaluate if you can support EV charging station plans?
* Make sure you can accommodate the needs of a new construction site?
* Check if you will need to replace some assets soon?

depsys offers you all the GridEye monitoring possibilities and a Health Check report of your desired grid area during one quarter.

Name: RIGOL Technologies EU GmbH
Description:
RIGOL Technologies Co., LTD. an ISO9001:2015 Quality Management System and ISO14001:2015 Environmental Management System Certified company, is one of the worldwide leaders in test and measurement instrumentation. RIGOL's line of products includes Digital Oscilloscopes, RF Spectrum Analyzers, RF Signal Sources, Digital Multimeters, Function/Arbitrary Waveform Generators, Electronic Loads and Digital Programmable Power Supplies.
Our test solutions combine uncompromised product performance, quality, and advanced product features; all delivered at extremely attractive price points. This combination provides our customers with unprecedented value for their investment, reduces their overall cost of test, and helps speed time to completion of their designs or projects.
RIGOL in Shuzhou, China and their US Headquarters in Beaverton, OR, and the EU Headquarters in Gilching/Munich, offers products and services in more than 80 countries/regions on six continents, with over 100 distributors and representatives.
For technical details and more information about RIGOL please visit www.rigol.eu or contact us at info-europe@rigol.com.

Name: Somfy DACH
Description:
With more than 175 million motors sold, Somfy is the world leader in automatic controls for openings and closures in homes and buildings. The company is also a pioneer in the field of Smart Home and Smart Building – running over five million connected devices in total. With an average of 40 new patents per year, Somfy has demonstrated its vision and innovative strength for 50 years. The company launched the first tubular motor for awnings in 1969, introduced io homecontrol as one of the first bidirectional radio protocols in 2007, and is currently focusing on an interoperable smart home world with TaHoma and the "So Open" initiative. The incentive of the workforce is also the company motto: "Inspiring a better way of living accessible to all". The company`s focus is on comfort, safety, sustainability and energy savings. Somfy speaks the customer's language from the end consumer to the installers, from industrial companies to architects and planners. 

The Somfy Group, with its headquarters in Cluses (France) employs a total of 6,070 people in around 60 countries. In 2019, the family-owned company achieved a total turnover of 1.2 billion euros. One of the main markets is the so called 'DACH' region - 400 employees work in Germany (Rottenburg), Austria (Elsbethen-Glasenbach) and Switzerland (Bassersdorf).

Name: CUPOWER
Description:
CUPOWER, established in 2009, specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of high-quality LED drivers and intelligent lighting control accessories.


With over a decade of expertise in designing and manufacturing LED components, our product range 

includes more than 300 cutting-edge products tailored for the global market. Beyond our comprehensive standard offerings, we welcome the opportunity to create fully customized and bespoke solutions to meet the unique requirements of our valued clients.

At the core of our success is a highly innovative R&D department, continually pushing the boundaries of LED driver technology. Coupled with our deep expertise in process-oriented production, we develop sophisticated, reliable, and efficient LED drivers that meet the highest industry standards.

Our fully integrated in-house capabilities, from sheet metal forming and plastic injection molding to assembly and rigorous testing, allow us to maintain efficient, flexible, and high-quality production processes. This end-to-end control ensures we provide consistent service while optimizing the use of resources, driving both sustainability and cost-effectiveness.

At CUPOWER, our daily mission is to not only meet but exceed your expectations, delivering solutions that power your success!

Name: SOMMER Antriebs- und Funktechnik GmbH
Description:
The SOMMER Antriebs- und Funktechnik GmbH (the subsidiary SOMMER DOCO in UK) is one of the leading manufacturers of high-quality garage door operators, swing gate operators, sliding gate operators, roller shutter operators and awning operators as well as radio remote controls for home automation in Europe.

SOMMER places great value on excellent quality and outstanding service. For this reason, we sell our manufactured products exclusively via specialist retailers. Certification according to DIN EN ISO 9001 was granted in 1995. The customer-oriented SOMMER company philosophy has been codified in a set of company guidelines.

With an export ratio of approx. 80%, SOMMER has underscored its international competitiveness and successfully made inroads into the sometimes difficult foreign markets with "Quality made in Germany".

The SOMMER Group consists of SOMMER Antriebs- und Funktechnik GmbH, APERTO Torantriebe GmbH, Groke Türen GmbH, metaku Metall- und Kunststoffbau GmbH, Triebenbacher Betriebsgesellschaft mbH and DOCO International B.V. We are globally active with our own branch offices and representatives.

Legal information: https://www.sommer.eu/en/legal-information.html

Name: Lacon Electronic GmbH
Description:
Incap Electronics Germany - formely Lacon Electronic -  has operated as a full-service mechatronics supplier in Europe for 40 years and is one of the Top 20 EMS providers in Germany. Incap Germany achieves a turnover of more than 60 million euros annually. Incap sees itself as being an EMS accelerator and is able to realise complete products. We have grown steadily since 1985 and is based in Karlsfeld near Munich and employs around 250 people in Germany and 350 in its Romanian subsidiary. Incap Germany’s broad customer and product base includes broadliners and specialists from all industries, it mainly produces rail systems, mechanical engineering and box build, medical engineering, automotive and robotics, as well as innovative consumer products. We support international technology corporations, SMEs and innovative start-ups. In addition to its development and production business, it also sells electromechanical components for cable and printed board connection technology and for box build. We support and advise our customers purposefully, from the prototyping to the industrialisation through to the complete series, for the entire life cycle of the products.

Incap Electronics Germany has embedded development, Connectivity Solutions and high-volume production facilities in Romania. We cover the complete production service for electronic modules, devices and systems along the entire value chain. Incap Germany develops, optimises and produces electronic and electromechanical modules and devices with any production depth. Incap Electronics Romania produces with German quality standards at Romanian factor costs. Our Embedded Systems division develops customer-specific hardware and software for industrial automation. 

(https://www.lacon.de/en/legal-notice/)

Name: MENTOR GmbH & Co. Präzisions-Bauteile KG
Description:
We are specialists for integrated lighting solutions and mechanical, electronic, and optoelectronic HMI components. For renowned automotive manufacturers as well as customers from the consumer and capital goods industries, we develop LED-based lighting components that add functional, aesthetic, and emotional value to products. With innovative strength, state-of-the-art equipment, and decades of know-how, we create solutions that offer orientation in a world of increasingly complex and multifunctional products via intelligent lighting systems, create atmosphere and comfort, enable communication and intuitive operation, and shape identity. With excellent advice, we support our customers in realising innovative and future-oriented products. Our management systems for quality and environmental management as well as information security are regularly checked in internal and external audits and thus form the basis for ensuring that our products and processes meet all required specifications as well as legal requirements. 

Imprint: https://www.mentor.de.com/impressum/ 
Netiquette: https://www.mentor.de.com/en/imprint/#netiquette

Name: ORTEC
Description: ORTEC is a global manufacturer of radiation detectors and nuclear instrumentation used by government and industrial laboratories, nuclear facilities, medical research, nuclear safeguards, and homeland security professionals.  Specializing in radioisotope identification and High Purity Germanium detectors, ORTEC has been a technology leader in the nuclear field for over 50 years.  ORTEC is a global brand under the Electronics Instruments group of AMETEK.  The Company refines and grows their own HPGe crystals for radiation detectors at their manufacturing facility in Oak Ridge, TN, USA

Name: ETI Electrotechnical - Protection of electrical installations
Description:
Since 1950 until now, ETI Elektroelement has grown into a world's leading provider of products and services in the field of protection of electrical installations, and into an important manufacturer of technical ceramic products. 

ETI Elektroelement is among five largest producers of fuses in the world and one of the the leading producers of innovative switches and circuit breakers. ETI's products (fuses, MCBs, MCCBs and ACBs) cover the range from 0,5A to 6300A and we can provide individual products and product lines or complete, integral solutions for control and protection of residential, commercial, industrial installations as well as those for electric power distribution, photovoltaic systems and other renewable energy sources.

ETI group consists of 14 subsidiaries in various European countries and we closely cooperate with selected partners all over the world. We are large enough to make a reliable partner with a complete range of products and services, and yet small enough to remain flexible and open to our customers‘ specific needs.

ETI is investing a lot into research, development and innovative activities. We are pioneers in the field of protection of photovoltaic systems and co-creators of international standards in the field of fuses and switchgear. 

The quality of ETI's products and services is constantly aimed at achieving customers' satisfaction and corresponding business excellence. All our products are internationally certified.

ETI Elektroelement has succeeded in creating an internationally competitive, development-oriented and stable business group, whose growth couldn't be stopped neither by extreme pressure of competition nor the last years' recession. Our future will continue to be built upon high-quality offer of complete palette of products and services, on strengthening the flexibility and competitiveness, on mastering new products, while the profit will still be invested into knowledge, market and technological development.

Name: Vision Components GmbH
Description: Vision Components is a leading international manufacturer of embedded vision systems with over 25 years of experience. The product range extends from versatile MIPI camera modules to freely programmable board cameras with ARM/Linux and OEM systems for 2D and 3D image processing. The company was founded in 1996 by Michael Engel, inventor of the first industrial-grade intelligent camera. VC operates worldwide, with sales offices in the USA and Japan and local partners in over 25 countries.

Name: ALPS ALPINE Europe
Description:
Alps Alpine offers products and services in a wide range of markets such as Automotive, Mobile Devices, Games to Industrial Equipment through our three business segments of Components, Sensor and Communication, and Module and System. In addition, we are creating solutions in new fields, in particular IoT. 

In Europe, Alps Alpine focuses on: 

1.	Automotive System and Modules
2.	Industrial Asset Tracking Solutions (Check out our LinkedIn Page "Asset Management Solutions")
3.	Electronic Components including sensors. 

To date, ALPS ALPINE has built up technology and experience to support product creation by more than 2,000 companies worldwide, a foundation for fulfilling society’s expectations as a partner in the design of functional devices the world needs.

Name: ELTAKO
Description:
ELTAKO ist ein in Europa führendes Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung, der Fertigung und dem Vertrieb von Schaltgeräten, Netzteilen, elektronischen Stromzählern, Gebäudefunk und Smart Home-Anwendungen für die Gebäudeinstallation und die Steuerungstechnik.

Das im Jahre 1949 gegründete familiengeführte Unternehmen ist eine GmbH und hat seinen Sitz in Fellbach, einer Stadt am Rande von Stuttgart in Baden-Württemberg. 

In einer ISO 9001:2000 zertifizierten Produktionsstätte in Shenzhen/China wird die Elektronik gefertigt. Die Entwicklung, die Qualitätssicherung, der Kundenservice, die Verkaufsleitung, das Marketing und die Verwaltung befinden sich am Firmensitz in Fellbach.

Description:
We do lighting for retail. We do the lot. We keep it simple.

We've been lighting up retail spaces for over 30 years. This is our speciality. To this end, we develop light concepts, market-appropriate standard and special products and services.
As a member of the Trilux Group, we are a single-source provider: in addition to effectively staging your sales floor, we can also illuminate secondary areas, whether indoors or outdoors, competently and economically.

We also provide the services you need, whether for light planning, custom logistic concepts or financing and leasing options.

Name: Z-LASER
Description:
Innovative light for better results. This is Z-LASER’s promise and obligation. Located in the heart of the Black Forest in Freiburg, Germany, Z-LASER has been developing and producing innovative, high-quality laser solutions for over 35 years. By providing visual guidance and orientation for people as well as machines, our lasers contribute to optimizing your production processes, ensuring quality, and to using resources carefully.

Sharp Lines, Complex Patterns
Z-LASER’s product range includes lasers for positioning, lasers for machine vision, laser projectors, and OEM laser systems. The positioning lasers’ acute, visually distinct laser lines enable precise alignment and positioning on virtually any surface. Lasers for machine vision, in combination with an industrial camera, capture the spatial contours of moving and non-moving objects to automate optical quality control and much more. Laser projectors are an optical guidance aid for people and machines, projecting variable patterns and guidance lines for step-by-step assembly processes. And OEM laser systems are manufactured according to your specific, individual requirements.  

Versatile Application, Trusting Cooperation
With over 120 employees and more than 60 trading partners, Z-LASER has been globally successful in numerous industries for decades. From wood processing and electronics manufacturing to textile and paper production, to the automotive and building materials industries – laser innovations from Freiburg are used wherever reliable precision and efficient high-performance processes are called for.

Name: Attema B.V.
Description:
Attema is an ambitious developer and producer of innovative solutions. These are applicable to different areas in the market: Installation, Building & Connectivity.

Motivated professionals
Attema is made up of a strong and motivated team of highly qualified professionals. People who stimulate each other in order to reach beyond their boundaries and who are given all the freedom necessary in order to develop themselves. 

The customer is always central
Attema employees always listen closely to their customers so they know better than anyone else what's happening in the market. This results in the creation of continually surprising products with clearly added specific value for each customer. Combined with efficient logistics and personal service this creates a maximum of customer satisfaction. 

Attention to human beings and to the environment 
In being part of an ever changing society Attema takes its social responsibility very seriously, which is expressed in policies that visibly respect both the human and the environmental aspect.

Name: Magritek
Description:
Magritek creates innovative products in the fields of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Magritek's products are grouped into Analytical Instruments, Oil and Gas Solutions, Portable Research Tools, and Education systems.

Magritek recently launched Spinsolve, the world's fastest benchtop NMR Spectrometer, which provides high resolution NMR spectra in the lab, in just seconds.

In Oil and Gas Solutions, our latest product is the 2 MHz Rock Core Analyzer, designed for specific measurements on rock core samples from hydrocarbon reservoirs.

Magritek has advanced tools for the research laboratory. Our most popular product in this category is our Kea2 Series Spectrometer, a powerful, compact, fully digital spectrometer with models operating from DC to 400 MHz.

Name: BECOM Group
Description:
BECOM has been a reliable electronics engineering, manufacturing and service partner for its clients in industry since 1984. From the first creative concept through the development and validation stages, right up to series production, its clients can obtain everything from a single source. Thanks to international business locations and partners, today’s clients around the world benefit from the high-quality solutions, services and know-how provided by our experts.

The time-of-flight specialist BECOM Systems became part of the BECOM Group in 2016. BECOM thereby expanded its business area with innovative sensor solutions and has subsequently been able to offer its clients the decades of experience of this domestic time-of-flight pioneer. BECOM’s scope of services and stability thus supplemented the innovative capacity of
BECOM Systems, and guaranteed long-term availability and highly-efficient production processes for its clients.

BECOM remains a family-run business to this day. With roots in the Burgenland state of Austria, over the years the corporation has developed world-class solutions and quality. Healthy but consistent growth and an instinct for innovative developments make BECOM the go-to choice for clients working in every sector.

Name: Thermopads Private Limited
Description:
Committed to Innovation, Excellence and Quality, sensitive to customer needs and backed by years of experience in the field of heating, Thermopads has the unique distinction of offering a heating solution for almost every domestic, commercial and industrial application. It is one of the top 5 global companies manufacturing Electrical surface heating systems. 

Thermopads serves 200 clients across 90 countries using the latest manufacturing techniques and cutting-edge technologies that ensure highest quality products. Catering to industries from Comfort heating  & Snow melting  to Refineries, Petro chemical plants, Power plants, we offer wide range of products that includes Electrical heat tracers, Heated tubing bundles, Panel heaters for various industrial applications to Under floor heating mats/ cables, Snow melting Mats/ Cables, Freeze protection Cables for various domestic and commercial application.

Our products are certified by reputed labs such as Intertek Semko, SGS Fimko, CSA, UL, VDE, EAC, IEX Ex, SIRA-ATEX (Ex) and we are an ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 Certified Organization. We have a strong relation with most of the leading international consultants and reputed OEM’s and EPC contractors. 

Our warehousing facility is located in UK and Netherlands. The appreciation we receive from our customers across India, Middle East, Europe, North America and Africa drives our passion for excellence.

Name: Bixolon Europe GmbH
Description:
BIXOLON is a leading global manufacturer of dependable innovative and advanced printing technologies that include POS, Auto ID and Mobile receipt & label printers for a range of environments. BIXOLON views its printing technology as an essential tool for any business and holds itself to the highest standards, since dedication to customers is its core belief.

BIXOLON’s FAST, FLEXIBLE and FRIENDLY approach to business has much to do with its recent success.

Name: OPSIS AB
Description:
OPSIS AB develops, manufactures, and sells instruments and software for monitoring air quality and gas emissions in both ambient environments and industrial processes.

We provide measurement solutions for:
• ambient air quality monitoring (air pollution in outdoor environments)
• industrial emissions and process gas monitoring
• laboratory analysis instruments for the food industry and other sectors (LiquidLINE and Liquid Monitoring)

Our systems are used by environmental authorities, industrial companies, and laboratories to accurately measure, monitor, and report air pollution and gas emissions.

OPSIS operates globally, with direct presence in Sweden, Denmark, and Norway. In other markets, we work through a worldwide network of subsidiaries, distributors, and partners who provide sales, installation, and service support.

Name: Munk GmbH
Description:
For 50 years MUNK is one of the leading manufacturers of DC and AC power supplies for electrochemical processes.
Innovative thinking is the prerequisite for creating sustainable products. Therefore, MUNK GmbH not just manufactures power supplies for the safe operation of your process but also considers the development of new ideas as an investment in the future.

All this is based on an extensive knowledge of designing rectifiers for industrial applications in the range of 2 to 1,000 Volts and 1 to 100,000 Amperes.

Name: Theben Nederland
Description:
Since the foundation of the company almost 90 years ago, this Swabian family business has developed into a successful company with 550 employees in Germany, five subsidiaries in Europe and branches in more than 50 countries all over the world.

Beyond our main focus of "time control," our core competences now include: 

1.Light control through twilight switches and presence and motion detectors.
2.Climate control through analogue and digital clock thermostats for room-by-room control.
3.KNX components for building systems engineering: from light and climate control to fully automated shutters and blinds run by a KNX weather station.
4.OEM solutions for providers of heating systems, operating systems, and control engineering as well as energy suppliers.

Name: addSensors
Description:
Enter the world of foil sensors and learn about the advantages of addSensors technology. Foil sensors provide new insights and added value in places where conventional sensor technology can' t reach due to size or costs. 
Our foil-based sensors are thin, flexible and can be easily retrofitted into your product without having to adapt it. In addition to single measurement values, such as temperature, humidity, pH, or pressure, several parameters can be combined in one multiparametric foil sensor.

addSensors is divided into 2 divisions:

Commodity Sensors 
Our commodity sensors are designed to give everyone quick and easy access to foil sensor technology. For this purpose we produce many different measuring values on different materials in small quantities.

Customized Sensors
Not found the right one? You need sensors customized for your application? We are flexible - just like our materials and production partners. Our team is sure to find the right solution for your application.

Name: Test Research, Inc. (TRI)
Description: TRI offers the most robust product portfolio in the industry for Automatic Test and Inspection solutions. From Solder Paste Inspection (SPI), Automated Optical Inspection (AOI), and 3D Automated X-ray Inspection (AXI) systems to Manufacturing Defect Analyzers (MDAs) and In-Circuit Test equipment (ICT), TRI provides the most cost-effective solutions to meet a comprehensive range of manufacturing Test and Inspection requirements.

Name: GTK UK Ltd
Description:
GTK is a subsidiary of Volex plc, a $1,000M AIM listed business.

Headquartered in the UK, we are a global provider of electronic solutions, delivering expertise in cable assemblies, connectors, displays, manufacturing services, and the latest generation of Volex power cords.

Our manufacturing facilities in the UK and Romania are accredited to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and UL standards, with our UK site also holding the AS9100D certification required for the Aerospace, Defence, and Security sectors. In addition, we collaborate with trusted affiliate partners across Asia to extend our global manufacturing footprint.

Our dedicated sales and product engineering teams support customers at every stage, from new product design and BOM cost-down initiatives to component alternatives and tailored build models. This partnership-driven approach ensures optimised product designs, manufacturing flexibility, and competitive pricing across a diverse range of markets.

Name: BBC Bircher Smart Access
Description:
BBC Bircher Smart Access, formerly Bircher Reglomat, develops, produces and distributes intelligent sensor solutions for access systems. With people and vehicle flows growing around the world, ever greater demands are being placed on access points. 
Bircher’s solutions meet the increasing needs for safety, hygiene, accessibility and energy efficiency. Not only are Bircher’s sensor solutions characterised by the company’s comprehensive product portfolio and an international manufacturing network, but they also stand out from the crowd thanks to the dedication and teamwork of its approximately 180 employees and their extensive technological expertise. 
For more than 60 years, Bircher has been fulfilling the specific needs of its international clients with an extended distribution network spanning Europe, Asia and North America. BBC Bircher Smart Access has been a business unit of the BBC Group since 1991.

Further information can be found on our website: www.bircher.com

Name: Kopp
Description:
Die Heinrich Kopp GmbH gehört zu den führenden deutschen Herstellern elektrotechnischer Produkte und Komponenten für den Fachhandel und für den Einzelhandel. Das Sortiment umfasst über 7.000 Artikel in den Segmenten Professional und Do it yourself. Es reicht von klassischen Stecker- und Schalterprogrammen über Dimmer, Präsenzmelder und mobile Personenschutzschalter bis hin zu innovativen Home-Automation- und Gebäudemanagement-Systemen, Photovoltaik-Lösungen sowie Lade- und Speichertechnologien. Neben den Lagerartikeln entwickelt und produziert Kopp ebenfalls kundenspezifische Lösungen aus dem Elektrobereich, wie Industriesteckdosenleisten für den Einsatz an Elektrofahrzeugen oder Motorschalter, die in Elektrogeräten verbaut werden. 

Das Unternehmen vertreibt seine Produkte sowohl in zahlreichen europäischen Ländern als auch weltweit und unterhält neben der Zentrale in Kahl am Main (Bayern) drei weitere Standorte in den Niederlanden, Österreich und Tunesien. Insgesamt beschäftigt Kopp 460 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, darunter 200 am Stammsitz. 

Qualität hat bei Kopp höchste Priorität, deshalb lässt sich das Unternehmen bereits seit 1993 freiwillig nach DIN ISO 9001:2015 prüfen und zertifizieren, ist seit nahezu 50 Jahren Mitglied der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Qualität e. V. und gewährt eine 20-jährige Garantie auf Schalterprogramme. 

Auch Nachhaltigkeit ist von jeher wichtiger Bestandteil der Unternehmensphilosophie. Kopp strebt eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Umweltleistungen durch die Optimierung der Prozesse, Methoden und den entsprechenden Einsatz von Materialien und Produkten an. So wurde Kopp bereits mehrfach für seine Maßnahmen zur Reduktion des Kohlenstoffdioxidausstoßes und im Bereich Ressourceneinsparung (Recycling) ausgezeichnet und zertifiziert. Geschäftsführer sind Stephan Dörrschuck und Markus Hornung.

Name: Pickering Electronics
Description:

WARUM wir tun, was wir tun: 
Unser Herz schlägt für das Thema „Nachhaltigkeit“. Aber wir sind gleichzeitig Techniker, Pragmatisten und vor allem selbst Unternehmer. Wir verstehen, dass Sie als Geschäftsführer eines produzierenden Unternehmens eine große Hauptaufgabe haben: Das wirtschaftliche Wachstum Ihres Unternehmens zu sichern. Denn ohne wirtschaftliches Wachstum können Sie nichts produzieren. Ohne wirtschaftliches Wachstum können keine Gehälter bezahlt werden. Ohne wirtschaftliches Wachstum gibt es keine Existenzgrundlage für Ihr Unternehmen.

Das Schöne an unserer Arbeit ist, dass wir unseren Kunden dabei helfen, Ihre wirtschaftlichen Ziele zu erreichen. Nachhaltigkeit gibt’s als Bonus dazu. Ganz von allein.

Wir haben uns bewusst dagegen entschieden, die Moralkeule für Nachhaltigkeit zu schwingen. Ganz im Sinne von: „Ihr Unternehmen muss sofort nachhaltig werden, weil ansonsten unser Planet stirbt!“ Wir machen lieber das: „Wir senken Ihre Kosten in der Produktion und setzen alles technisch für Sie um.“

Das sind wir: Pragmatisch, unaufgeregt und unkompliziert.

WAS wir tun: 
Wir reduzieren den Energieverbrauch und sparen so Kosten bei produzierenden Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Raum. Nachhaltigkeit gibt es als Bonus dazu. Ganz automatisch.

WIE wir es tun: 
Mit einer Vorort-Begehung Ihrer Anlagen. Wir analysieren Druckluft, Elektromotore, Beleuchtung und alle anderen Bereiche Ihres Unternehmens. Wir sagen Ihnen ganz genau, wo und wie Sie bei geringstem Zeitaufwand Ihre Kosten in der Produktion dauerhaft senken können. Wir beantragen für Sie auch staatliche Förderungen. 

Für Sie zur Info: Der Staat investiert im großen Stil in Unternehmen, die nachhaltiger werden wollen. Das ist quasi Geld, das auf der Straße liegt und wir nur aufheben müssen. 
Und: Wir setzen alles technisch für Sie um. Sie haben keinen Aufwand. 
Denn wir wissen, dass Sie alle Hände voll zu tun haben, Ihr Unternehmen zu führen.

Description:
E-mobility is the promise of a more sustainable and efficient way of transportation, and E-bikes, especially, gradually change our very experience of daily commutes.

However, e-Bikes have yet to reach their full potential, and it is obvious that there is a lot of room for improvement

Driven by the opportunity to further improve on this technology, two students from the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) decided to take action and embarked on a journey which finally led to MoThor in late 2020, and its first product being developed:

A modular battery system, designed to have its elements stay in circulation for as long as possible, making life easier for the manufacturer while drastically reducing its impact on the environment. Convenient access to the different components ensures easy repairability and separation of defectives components. This gives the opportunity to greatly increase the lifespan of the battery and to properly dispose of it when it comes to it. With even more unique features on their way, the Mothor Battery pack promises to bring more options to user and manufucturer. 

With seven members already, MoThor has gained its first momentum in a rapidly growing market but there still is a lot of work to be done to reach our goal to have every E-Bike powered by a battery pack that is truly part of a circular economy. So feel free to join us on our journey to a bettery future by visiting our website, sending us a message, and subscribing to our newsletter.

Wir möchten das Konzept "Künstlicher Weihnachtsbaum" auf ein neues Level bringen und einen künstlichen Weihnachtsbaum entwickeln, der einem echten Baum in Nichts nachsteht. Warum einen anderen Weihnachtsbaum kaufen, wenn es ArtiTree gibt?

Jan und Björn verbindet Weihnachten schon seit ihrer Kindheit. Was macht ArtiTree so besonders?
Bei ArtiTree gibt es nicht nur einfach ein Produkt, sondern ein von Anfang bis Ende durchdachtes Kundenerlebnis. Dazu gibt es innovative Features, die unsere ArtiTree Weihnachtsbäume einzigartig machen.

Welche Probleme der Kunden werden durch ArtiTree gelöst?
Wir bieten unseren Kunden eine Lösung für die Nachteile eines echten Weihnachtsbaumes. Unsere Bäume nadeln nicht, verteilen kein klebriges Harz, sehen immer frisch aus, sind wiederverwendbar und lassen sich ohne viel Dreck auf- und abbauen.
Dadurch kann die Weihnachtszeit voll und ganz genossen werden.

Maßgeschneiderte Systemlösungen sind das Markenzeichen des renommierten Unternehmens. 
Das Portfolio der AEG ID ruht auf zwei Säulen: Transponder und die entsprechend der Applikation optimal abgestimmten Lesegeräte. Die Transponder, deren Gehäuse für jeden Einsatzzweck optimiert werden können, erfüllen typische Anforderungen wie geringe Größe, leichte Befestigung, große Leseabstände, Unempfindlichkeit gegen Feuchtigkeit, hohe Temperaturen und Einsatz in rauer Umgebung. Sie spielen in der Automatisierung, Diebstahlsicherung, Logistik, bei der Zugangskontrolle und Zeiterfassung, der Tieridentifizierung, der Identifizierung von Müll, Gasflaschen, bei Mehrwegcontainern oder Europaletten eine zentrale Rolle.

Name: Second Life Batteries GmbH
Description:
SL Batteries dismantles traction batteries, tests and classifies them at the end of their first life cycle in order to provide a second long period of use. After the second life of use, SL Batteries recovers valuable material for new battery cells or alternative industrial applications.

The aim of our company is to continuously increase the number and availability of 'Second Life' battery modules through integrated solutions for sustainable energy storage.

Name: Brüder Mannesmann Werkzeuge
Description:
Die Brüder Mannesmann Werkzeuge GmbH, gegründet 1931, ist ein traditioneller Hersteller von Hand- und Elektrowerkzeugen mit Sitz in Remscheid. 

Mit über 90 Jahren Erfahrung bieten wir unseren Kunden weltweit hochwertige Werkzeuge, die durch Präzision, Langlebigkeit und Innovation überzeugen.

Unser Sortiment umfasst mehr als 2.000 Produkte, die in der Industrie, im Handwerk und im Fachhandel für unterschiedlichste Anwendungen eingesetzt werden. Wir setzen auf höchste Qualität, kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und nachhaltige Produktion, um unseren Kunden stets die besten Lösungen zu bieten.

Als einer der führenden Anbieter in der Werkzeugbranche sehen wir uns als zuverlässigen Partner unserer Kunden und legen großen Wert auf langfristige, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen. Qualität, exzellenter Service und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden stehen für uns stets an oberster Stelle.

Unsere Werte basieren auf Innovation, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit, die den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens maßgeblich prägen. Wir investieren kontinuierlich in die Verbesserung unserer Produkte und Fertigungsprozesse, um den sich ständig verändernden Marktanforderungen gerecht zu werden. Durch die Verbindung traditioneller Handwerkskunst mit modernen Technologien streben wir danach, unseren Kunden zuverlässige Werkzeuge zu bieten, die ihre täglichen Herausforderungen effizient und nachhaltig meistern.

Name: BION TECHNOLOGIES GmbH
Description:
Innovative Lighting Solutions für anspruchsvolle Architekturinszenierungen im Innen- wie auch Außenbereich.

Name: Utsch Huber Lichtsysteme GmbH
Description: Wir sind die Lichtplanung - und Vertriebsgesellschaft für den Innenleuchten- und Außenleuchten-Bereich. Wir verstehen uns als Mittler zwischen unseren mittelständischen Leuchtenherstellern und dem Leuchtenmarkt. Als Partner der Architekten, der Elektroplaner und der Anwender, beraten wir über die Innovationen des Licht- und Leuchtenmarktes und realisieren kreative Lichtlösungen für unsere Kunden.

Name: LEDIM GmbH
Description: LED Dimmer, Driver, 100% Flickerfree, LED Engines, Dim2warm, Dim2zero, Dim2dark, Tunable White, analog LED dimming

Name: Robomow GmbH
Description:
Robomow ist einer der weltweit führende Hersteller von Mährobotern.
Unser Kompetenz ist das entwickeln und produzieren von Mähroboter für den Markt.

Willkommen zu einem komplett neuen Mäherlebnis!

Die Mähroboter von Robomow passen genau zu Ihrem Lebensstil und fügen sich sofort in Ihr Zuhause, Ihren Garten und Ihre Familie ein.

Robomow-Mäher wurden für die einfachste, bequemste und schnellste Art, Rasen zu mähen, entwickelt. Sie sind gartenfreundlich (sie werden fernab vom Rasen installiert), benutzerfreundlich (sie kommunizieren mit Ihrem Smartphone) und familienfreundlich (Ihr Rasen, Ihr Terminplan)!

Besuchen Sie uns auf www.robomow.com um aktuell Updates und Nachrichten über Robomow und der Mähroboter-Industrie zu bekommen.

Name: RADWAG Waagen GmbH
Description:
RADWAG ist der größte Hersteller elektronischer Waagen in Polen und zählt zu den weltweit führenden Anbietern dieser Branche. Neben unserem Hauptsitz in Radom verfügen wir über acht Niederlassungen in Polen sowie acht internationale Vertretungen.

Unser Portfolio umfasst Labor- und Industriewaagen, medizinische Waagen, automatische Waagen sowie Waagen für explosionsgefährdete Bereiche (Ex-Schutz). Darüber hinaus bieten wir hochpräzise Massekomparatoren sowie zahlreiche weitere innovative Lösungen an.

Wenn Sie unser vollständiges Angebot kennenlernen möchten, besuchen Sie gerne unsere Website: www.radwag.com/de

Name: Tessonics Europe GmbH
Description:
Tessonics Europe GmbH is a sister company of Tessonics Inc. located in Windsor, Canada. We provide solutions for non-destructive testing (NDT) using ultrasound for resistance spot welding points and adhesions especially for the automotive industry. To better meet the needs of our customers in the outstanding European automotive industry, Tessonics Europe GmbH was established at the end of 2017.  Tessonics Europe GmbH not only provides the products of Tessonics, Inc, Canada but also offers application tests and training for non-destructive testing of resistance spot welds with ultrasound.


Die Tessonics Europe GmbH ist eine Schwesterfirma der etablierten Tessonics Inc. (Windsor, Kanada) und bietet Lösungen für die zerstörungsfreie Prüfung (ZfP) mit Ultraschall von Widerstandsschweißpunkten und Verklebungen vor allem in der Automobilindustrie an.
Auf die herausragende Stellung der europäischen Automobilindustrie und um auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden noch besser eingehen zu können, wurde die Tessonics Europe GmbH Ende 2017 gegründet und vertreibt nicht nur die Produkte der Firma Tessonics Inc., sondern bietet auch Applikationsuntersuchungen und Schulungen zur zerstörungsfreien Prüfung von Widerstandsschweißpunkten mit Ultraschall an.

Name: iie GmbH & Co. KG
Description:
Als Systempartner mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung in der Leistungselektronik bieten wir Ihnen hoch effiziente und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für Ihre Applikation an.
Unsere neueste Generation von DC/DC-Wandlern basiert auf modernster SiC-FET-Technologie. Die kompakten Module sind bis in den Megawattbereich kaskadierbar und bieten einen enormen Wirkungsgrad bei höchsten Leistungsdichten.
Für den bestmöglichen Wirkungsgrad Ihrer Applikation unterstützt Sie unser Team von der Auslegung der Topologie bis hin zum Service im Feld.
Dank der Eigenentwicklung und -fertigung des gesamten Systems sind wir Ihr zuverlässiger Partner in allen Projektphasen.

Name: Hanna Instruments Deutschland GmbH
Description: Hanna Instruments Deutschland GmbH is the German subsidiary of Hanna Instruments, Inc., which is the world’s largest privately held manufacturer of electro analytical instrumentation. Since 1978 Hanna has produced practical, cost effective devices for Lab, Environmental, Food and Industry applications. We offer a wide array of instrumentation, from research grade bench tops, and ISE’s, to single and multiparameter portable meters for testing pH, conductivity, DO, turbidity and more. Hanna has over 40 offices worldwide to ensure exceptional levels of service and support anywhere in the world.

Name: Mocotech GmbH
Description:
Mocotech GmbH is a medium-sized enterprise headquartered in Rheinberg, Germany and established in 2000. As experts in medium voltage motor controller and power factor correction, we provide as a reliable partner our products and solutions for the individual application of our customers.

Mocotech GmbH stands for innovation, competence, quality and economy. Our core business is the development and production of soft starters, Kordörfer autotransformer starter, switchgears and capacitor banks as well as the installation and commissioning of our products.

Mocotech GmbH is accredited acc. to ISO 9001 and our products meet highest international standards.

Increase your process stability and quality with products and solutions from Mocotech GmbH.

Name: SEBO Stein& Co. GmbH
Description:
Der erste SEBO wurde 1978 für die hohen Ansprüche von Profis entwickelt: innovativ, gründlich, ergonomisch und ökonomisch. In kürzester Zeit wurde das junge Unternehmen SEBO Stein & Co. aus Velbert in Deutschland zum Weltmarktführer für hochwertige Bürststaubsauger im Objektbereich.

SEBO steht für technische Innovation und intelligente Detaillösungen. Viele gute Ideen von SEBO sind zum Maßstab für erstklassige Staubsauger geworden, zum Beispiel der patentierte Stoßschutz Airbelt und der integrierte Handsaugschlauch bei SEBO Bürststaubsaugern.

SEBO Bürst- und Bodenstaubsauger sind in jeder Hinsicht optimierte Werkzeuge für die Reinigung und Pflege von Teppichen und Hartböden. Sie sind technisch durchdacht und ausgereift, solide verarbeitet, leicht zu bedienen und funktional gestaltet. Die qualitativ hochwertigen Produkte werden ausschließlich am Standort Velbert entwickelt und produziert. Über sechs Millionen verkaufte Staubsauger beweisen die exzellente Leistung von SEBO.

Heute sind SEBO Staubsauger auf dem roten Teppich und auf dem glänzenden Parkett zu Hause. Sie werden im Weißen Haus in Washington, im Buckingham Palace in London, im Deutschen Bundestag in Berlin und in führenden Hotels der Welt, von Tokyo, Kapstadt, Paris bis Las Vegas und Singapur eingesetzt.

Name: Welltherm GmbH
Description:
Die Welltherm GmbH ist eines der führenden, europaweit agierenden Unternehmen im Bereich der Infrarotbeheizung. An unserem Entwicklungs- und Produktionsstandort in Lüdenscheid fertigen wir hochwertigste Infrarotheizsysteme. Ausgesuchte Komponenten, die sorgfältige Verarbeitung und die kundenindividuelle Fertigung unserer Produkte versprechen optimalen und nachhaltigen Heizkomfort. Welltherm Infrarotheizungen sind „Made in Germany“. Unsere VDE- und EMC-Zertifizierungen garantieren höchste Qualität und Produktsicherheit.

Welltherm Infrarotheizungen sind CO2-neutrale, autarke und nachhaltige Heizsysteme und damit DIE Alternative zur Wärme-pumpe sowie zu Gas-, Öl- und Nachtspeicherheizungen. Sie sind schnell und einfach installiert und eignen sich sowohl als Zusatzheizung als auch als zukunftsorientiertes Komplettheizsystem.

Name: Solfas Technologie GmbH
Description: Solfas Technologie GmbH is a measurement technology company serving clients globaly with custom high performance system solutions, test systems, power supplies and instrumentation. Since the year 2000 up to now our products and solutions are in use on 3 continents in 15 countries by companies. We offer a broad range of high performance full supported measuring instruments and test systems used in automotive, aerospace, energy and industry sector for testing high power components like chokes, transformers and electric motors.

Als zukunfts- und kundenorientiertes Unternehmen streben wir die Umsetzung neuester technischer Innovationen an und arbeiten für langfristige Partnerschaften und Kundenbeziehungen durch Einsatz und guten Service.
Es ist unser Anliegen Ihnen ein komplettes System aus einer Hand zu liefern, selbstverständlich mit der nötigen Beratung. Daher führen wir neben unseren verkaufsstärksten Lüftungsanlagen ergänzende Produkte und umfassendes optionales Zubehör.

Name: Partex D-A-CH
Description:

We manufacture products for the identification of wires, cables, pipes and components. From the individual electrician to the world’s largest companies, our unique marking systems contribute towards increased efficiency and higher safety levels.

Our decades of experience designing and manufacturing thin film metallization equipment translates into deep process knowledge and expertise in every dimension. Name: LAIR GmbH
Description:
GESUND UND SMART LEBEN - Mit LAIR

Ob Zuhause, im Büro oder in der Schule: 90 Prozent unserer Zeit verbringen wir in geschlossenen Räumen. Die Luftqualität dort ist entscheidend für Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und Leistungsfähigkeit. 
Die intelligenten Luftgütesensoren von LAIR messen Temperatur, Luftfeuchtigkeit,  CO2-Gehalt und die Konzentration von Schadstoffen (TVOCs). 
Anhand der Lichtfarbe des Ambient-Status-Lights des LAIR Luftgütesensors erkennen Sie auf einen Blick, wie die Luftqualität in Ihrer Umgebung ist und wann Sie z.B. lüften sollten. 
Ihre Raumluftdaten haben Sie immer im Blick - mit der LAIR App auf dem Tablet oder Smartphone.

Name: EVI New Energy
Description:
EVI New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. is a full-scenario EV charging solution provider, focusing on the R&D, manufacturing and sales of high-performance DC/AC chargers, V2X-enabled systems and smart energy management solutions.

Backed by a core team with over 20 years of experience from Fortune 500 companies including Huawei, ABB and Eaton, we deliver products that support peak shaving, dynamic tariff management and VPP integration for public, commercial and fleet applications.

With ISO 9001 certification, a 4,000m2 manufacturing base, and annual capacities of 3,600 DC chargers and 72,000 AC chargers, we serve customers globally through our regional hubs in the USA, the Netherlands and Singapore.

We are committed to driving the clean energy transition with efficient, intelligent and safe charging solutions.

Microtronic was founded to serve its customer base by finding real solutions. Name: REDCATT
Description:
REDCATT is focused on the design and manufacturing of audio transducers and turn key speaker systems for both the professional and consumer market segments of the audio industry.

A new company, yes. New to the industry, definitely not!

The core engineering and manufacturing management work at REDCATT is managed and executed by staff with over 30 years of transducer design and manufacturing experience in the US, Europe, Australia and China.

REDCATT is a privately held company, established in 2014.

Our objective was to create a true state of the art facility and the initial investment for the desired manufacturing technologies was over 2mil USD

The company has strong financial backing and established key vendor relationships as well as extensive long term financing available for future growth

The core management team at REDCATT has been sourcing transducer components and building components, sub-assemblies and systems in China for over 20 years. We have direct experience with the challenges and risks of sourcing parts in China. Our factory, our communications style and business culture represent our experience and our desire to be “easy to work with”. To that end, we strive to be direct and transparent in all aspects of our customer relationships.

Our team has extensive experience in the audio industry in all engineering and development stages - from design and development to quality control and manufacturing. Our combined knowledge ensures we can design and produce the best speakers and systems while meeting your cost targets.

Our team members have been working all around the world for the biggest players in the audio market with direct R&D and manufacturing experience with companies like Mackie Designs, RCF, B&C Speakers, Rode Microphones, Event Electronics, Sonos etc. providing R&D engineering or setting up production facilities in Italy, Australia, Czech Republic and of course China.

Name: VennTec GmbH
Description:
VennTec GmbH hat eine Einsatzstellen- Markierungs-Leuchte (Produktname G.i.L) entwickelt, die Einsatzkräften wie Feuerwehr, Polizei, Rettungsdienst und anderen Hilfsorganisationen hilft, Ihre Einsatzstelle zu optimieren und zu strukturieren.
Unser Motto: "Save time to save lives!"

G.i.L (Go in Light) ist die Markierungsleuchte inklusive Etagenanzeige, die durch eine Trägerplatte auf fast allen Untergründen, mittels einer Klebetechnik innerhalb von Sekunden befestigt werden kann, ohne dabei Rückstände zu hinterlassen. G.i.L dient zur Markierung von Einsatzstellen jeglicher Art. Durch den Gebrauch der Markierungsleuchte ist für jede Einsatzkraft schnell ersichtlich, wo sich der Zugang zum Schadensereignis befindet. Die Markierungsleuchte zeichnet sich durch ihre schnelle und einfache Anwendung sowie durch ihre sehr hohe Qualität aus. Mit G.i.L kann lebenswichtige und kostbare Zeit eingespart werden.
G.i.L ist die Markierungsleuchte:
-die, die Sicherheit der Einsatzkräfte erhöht. (schnelleres Auffinden)
-die eine einheitliche und eindeutige Markierung für alle Einsatzkräfte darstellt.
-die explosionsgeschützt- und somit vielseitig einsetzbar ist.
-die durch richtungsweisende Blinkmuster, die Einsatzkräfte schneller zum Schadensereignis führt.
-mit der sich die Schadensausbreitung, durch Zeitersparnis, um ein Vielfaches reduzieren lässt.
-die durch eine numerische Anzeige, beispielsweise nachfolgenden Kräften die Etage anzeigen kann.
-mit der sich eine Kostenreduktion pro Einsatz ergibt.
-mit der sich nachweislich Zeit einsparen lässt, die Geschädigten gewiss zugutekommt.
Unser Ziel ist es, den Einsatzkräften die Einsatzstelle Best möglichst zu optimieren und ihnen die Arbeit zu erleichtern, denn die Überlebenschancen von vermissten Personen im Brandrauch sinken laut Statistik pro Minute um 10%.
G.i.L wurde am 31.10.2018 vom DPMA patentiert. 
Ein europaweites Patent ist angemeldet.
G.i.L wurde am 29.07.2016 vom DPMA als Marke eingetragen.

Name: Resulo
Description:
Uns liegt das Thema Lebensmittelverschwendung sehr am Herzen. Schaut man genauer hin, sieht man, dass Backwaren dabei ein erheblicher Faktor sind. 30 % werden aktuell für die Tonne produziert, was vor allem am harten Wettbewerb mit billigem Industriebrot liegt. 

Bestimmt genießt auch du gerne beim Frühstück, in der Mittagspause oder Brotzeit die eine oder andere knusprige Backware und hast festgestellt, dass die Qualität zudem stetig abnimmt. Klar, kaum jemand will noch eine Ausbildung zum Bäcker machen. Mit ehrlicher Handwerkskunst, einem reduzierten Sortiment aus lokalen Biomehlen und ohne Zusätze, muss man extrem harte Arbeit in Kauf nehmen und trotzdem einen vielfachen Preis verlangen.

Eine einfache Win-Win Lösung wäre es, wenn jeder selbst Zuhause backt - das ist günstiger, gesünder, hält länger frisch, ist nachhaltiger und ganz ehrlich; wer gerne sein Essen genießt, der wird sicher vom Geschmack überzeugt.
Das einzige Problem ist, dass es für die Meisten zu stressig ist, das Backen in ohnehin schon überladene Tage zu integrieren und deswegen werden wir genau das lösen und das Backen von handwerklichem Brot (mit Sauerteig) alltagstauglich machen. Für jeden. 

Dazu entwickeln wir Tools, Anleitungen und neue Techniken. Auf unserer Reise ist ein Anstellgutautomat, der Sauerteig komplett sorgenfrei pflegt, die erste Station. Außerdem beschäftigen wir uns mit einer App, die die Planung deutlich vereinfacht und helfen schon beim Start der eigenen Hobbybäckerlaufbahn.

Envitron provides autonomous, fully automated roof monitoring systems that measure actual loads in real time – snow, ponding water and extra PV weight. Multiple sensors per roof zone reveal local hotspots caused by drifts or blocked drains. A clear traffic-light logic (green/amber/red) triggers e-mail/SMS alerts and stores everything in an online monitoring portal – including logs for audits, insurers and facility teams.
Why it matters: just a few centimeters of wet snow or 10–30 mm of standing water can add 30–120 kg/m2 of extra load. With envitron, operators detect this early and act proactively – not in emergency mode. Result: safer roofs, faster PV approvals, less downtime and proven risk reduction.

Description:
Martin Thacker, a Canadian expat, founder and CEO of Bronson, established the company in 2010 not long after he arrived in Berlin, Germany. At that time he was working as an artist and photographer with his North American 110-Volt photo equipment, which needed to be converted for the standard European electric system that operates at a 230-Volt grid. To his frustration, he found very limited options, the few solutions available being either unhandy or very expensive, finally deciding to develop his own simple, reliable and affordable solution for this problem. It quickly became clear that there was a larger user group with similar needs as travelers and other expats, trying to use electrical equipment overseas, from musical up to kitchen appliances. Since then, the business has continued to grow and extend its diverse range of power solutions, focusing on creating intelligent and well-designed products, it now serves markets beyond the household expat market including high tech companies and institutions that need to operate specialty equipment with specific power needs.
In 2018 the company launched the Bronson Outdoor project, embarking on a journey to develop products for the rapidly growing e-mobility market. Taking from our experience in power conversion technology and applying this to the marine and outdoor market, where there are very limited and often unaffordable solutions to help people transition from fuel-burning power to clean energy. Through lean product development and a highly efficient supply chain, we are now bringing to the market safe, reliable, and long-lasting power solution products developed at the highest quality while maintaining affordable prices.

Description:
PROAIR GmbH Gerätebau, based in Allgäu in southern Germany, manufactures the DELPHIN with great attention to detail. The DELPHIN is an air purification device that has become indispensable in modern households. Whether you use a mop, duster, steam cleaner, vacuum cleaner or other cleaning device, the DELPHIN replaces most of them with better results.
During development, the company's highly qualified engineers placed particular emphasis on putting people first. It is so easy to use that cleaning suddenly becomes fun. But above all, the effect and the great feeling of cleanliness are overwhelming.
In 2022, PROAIR GmbH was named one of the top 100 most innovative companies in Germany.
In the DELPHIN, water is swirled according to Viktor Schauberger's theories, which means that the air remains in the water for a particularly long time and the dirt and dust have plenty of time to combine with the water. This not only produces clean air, but also energetically treated air that feels as if you are standing in a forest and taking a deep breath.
As we use many of nature's principles, we want to give as much back to nature as possible. Since 2005, we have been producing significantly more energy with photovoltaics on the company's roofs than we consume in the production of DELPHIN. The quality and associated longevity of often more than 30 years also conserves resources and energy. Waste management and recycling are carried out throughout the entire company in a way that not only protects the environment but also reduces costs.
Today, we see many happy customers all over the world who have made their lives more liveable with DELPHIN. Cleanliness becomes a minor issue because DELPHIN simply takes care of it.
In addition to the many people in production, we also have many partners in sales who have secured their livelihood through DELPHIN.

Name: Power-To-Heat Infrared GmbH
Description:
The newly developed PtH infrared heater emits healthy, beneficial infrared rays. In contrast to convection heating (heating system with hot water circulation and radiators that heat the room air convectively), with IR heating the emitted heat radiation from all surfaces in the room (walls, ceiling, floor, objects, even human skin) is depending on the absorption coefficient absorbed and in turn emitted as long-wave thermal radiation. The room air is thus heated by the heat radiation of the IR heater and by the radiation of all heated surfaces. This is not only healthy, but also economical, in contrast to electric radiators, for example. 
While with convection heating there is inevitably a thermal stratification of the circulating room air (warm on top, cold below), with correctly dimensioned design all surfaces in the room reach a similar temperature after the heating-up phase of the infrared heater. This in turn requires greater heat storage so that, depending on the heat balance of the room, the room temperature can be maintained longer than with conventional convection heating.

DISPLAY: Super-bright displays with ultra-wide viewing angles. Portrait and landscape mode support with the same device.

TOUCH: State of the art projected capacitive touch sensors for accurate and reliable touch detection.

MECHANICAL: A diverse set of standard mechanical solutions is available, including rear or front mount, finished in different materials with many levels of ruggedizing options.

OPTICAL BONDING: Models with optically bonded display and touch sensor available. All sizes can be provided with physically hardened optically bonded safety glass.

SOFTWARE PLATFORM: Our rock solid Linux distribution board supports CODESYS, HTML5 (Chromium), QT5 QML/C++, Java, Mono and VNC client application environments.

DLOGIC was formed in 2008, and the EU office was established in 2017, in Altenburg, DE.

Description:

Bereits seit den 80er Jahren beschäftigen wir uns mir textilen Stickereien und gehören heute zu den renommiertesten Herstellern von textilen Heizelementen für die Automobilindustrie. Knapp 30.000 Sitzheizungen für Autos gehen wöchentlich vom Band. Mit diesem „Know How“ entwickelten wir eine einzigartige Infrarotheizung für den Wohnraum. Diese werden in einem 3-stöckigen Gebäude, auf 2200 m2 Nutzfläche, in Pfullingen bei Stuttgart produziert.

Mit den effizienten Infrarotheizungen von DIGEL HEAT schaffen Sie Wohlbefinden wie die Wärme unserer Sonne. Sie sind effizient wie kaum eine andere Heizung und so wirtschaftlich wie Sie es bei einer Elektroheizung nicht für möglich halten würden. Mit unserem Know-how beherrschen wir das Funktionsprinzip und die Materialverarbeitung so gut, dass wir leistungsfähige und qualitativ hochwertige Infrarotheizungen garantieren können. Entwicklung und Produktion finden an unserem Stammsitz in Pfullingen statt. Damit sind unsere Infrarotheizungen durch und durch „made in Germany“. 

Die Infrarotheiztechnik als solche ist bereits äußerst effizient. Doch das besondere Know-how von DIGEL HEAT in der Verarbeitung von Edelstahl-Heizleitern sorgt für eine wirklich außergewöhnliche Performance. Es basiert auf der millionenfachen Herstellung von Sitzheizungen für Autos. Perfekte Isolation, saubere Wärmeverteilung und ein hoher Strahlungsanteil sind Garanten für hohe Effizienz, egal ob bei der klassischen Infrarotheizung oder bei unserer Bildheizung, Glasheizung oder Spiegelheizung.

Educate: Workshops, curriculum, ecosystem tours and fractional mentorship from specialists who've shipped millions of units teach production thinking and inspire what's possible.

Equip: Software, resources, and production partnerships that turn ideas into shippable products, whether you're an influencer launching branded hardware or an AI engineer building a custom device.

Connect: Venture capital scouting, pilot customer matching, and market access across the US, China, and beyond to help innovators get their designs into the hands of people who need them.

MGC operates globally with offices in Dubai, Tokyo, Shenzhen, Berlin, and New York, supported by 80+ specialists across 6 continents, 700+ factory relationships, and distribution channels reaching 100M+ consumers.

For creators ready to launch a new hardware product: we help you see the whole picture, then de-risk every move.

Die Innovationsfähigkeit des Unternehmens spiegelt sich in einer Vielzahl von gewerblichen Schutzrechten wider, da wir Entwicklungen im Spannungsfeld zwischen Mensch und Technik mitgestalten. Name: LUMATEC
Description:
Our company's story began in 1976 with an innovation, the first flexible laser light guide. 

A few years later we developed the first infrared coagulator. It significantly simplified medical procedures involving tissue ablation. In those early years, we catered exclusively to the life sciences sector. 

In time our company branched out, going on to patent liquid light guides that inspired a host of unprecedented industrial applications. Our innovative UV light guides are a case point: Far more efficient at transmitting light than conventional silica fibers, they are also a good deal more affordable. That combination makes them the solution of choice for curing adhesives used in industrial manufacturing processes. 

The next logical step for LUMATEC was to add high-performance light sources to the product range. Today we provide superb UV light sources that serve customers well in non-destructive testing applications. Our multispectral light sources are also an excellent fit for forensics, where they help detect traces and collect evidence. These powerful scientific analysis tools also serve researchers well.

Over the years, LUMATEC has earned a reputation for being one of the most innovative providers of specialty lighting instruments. 

We owe our success to engineering expertise in three areas:

1) Liquid light guides offering unrivalled quality and performance
2) High-performance light sources
3) Excellence in optical technology for specialty lighting

Unsere Technik und unser Wissen sollen dazu betragen, dass dieses auch weiterhin möglich bleibt.

Name: Elektrotechnik Marashi
Description:
Elektroinstallationen in Wohngebäude und Gewerbe sind ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Elektrotechnik im Handwerk. Diese Installationen umfassen die Verlegung von elektrischen Leitungen, die Installation von Schaltern, Steckdosen und Beleuchtungssystemen sowie die Einrichtung von Sicherungskästen und Verteileranlagen. Im Wohngebäude werden Elektroinstallationen benötigt, um den Strombedarf der Bewohner zu decken. Dies beinhaltet die Verkabelung der Räume, um elektrische Geräte wie Lampen, Steckdosen, Herde, Kühlschränke und Waschmaschinen mit Strom zu versorgen. Zudem werden Sicherungskästen installiert, um die elektrische Sicherheit im Gebäude zu gewährleisten.

Die Photovoltaik spielt eine wichtige Rolle im Elektrotechnik Handwerk. Sie ermöglicht die Umwandlung von Sonnenenergie in elektrische Energie. Durch den Einsatz von Photovoltaikanlagen können Elektriker nachhaltige und umweltfreundliche Lösungen für ihre Kunden bieten. Diese Anlagen werden auf Dächern oder Freiflächen installiert und bestehen aus Solarzellen, die das Sonnenlicht in Strom umwandeln. Die gewonnene Energie kann entweder direkt genutzt oder in Batterien gespeichert werden. Die Photovoltaik ist somit ein zukunftsweisendes Thema im Elektrotechnik Handwerk, da sie zur Energiewende und zur Reduzierung von CO2-Emissionen beiträgt.

Wallbox ist ein Begriff, der in der Elektrotechnik verwendet wird. Eine Wallbox ist eine Ladestation für Elektrofahrzeuge, die an einer Wand montiert wird. Sie ermöglicht das sichere und effiziente Aufladen des Fahrzeugs. Die Wallbox wird direkt an das Stromnetz angeschlossen und verfügt über verschiedene Funktionen wie Überwachung der Ladeleistung, Ladesteuerung und Sicherheitsvorkehrungen. Sie ist eine praktische Lösung für Elektrofahrzeugbesitzer, da sie das Laden zu Hause oder an anderen geeigneten Orten ermöglicht. Mit einer Wallbox können Elektrofahrzeuge schnell und bequem aufgeladen werden, was zu einer effizienten Nutzung der Elektrotechnik beiträgt.
